## Miami & Miami Beach City Guide & Expansion Notes
Miami and **Miami Beach** are marquee coastal expansions in Upland, featuring waterfront properties, Art Deco district neighborhoods, high-value collections, and seasonal live events.

### Key Highlights of Miami & Miami Beach in Upland
1. **City Tier & Pricing:**
   - Miami and Miami Beach include a mix of **FSA (Fair Start Act)** starter neighborhoods and high-tier beachfront/coastal neighborhoods.
   - Waterfront and South Beach properties are among the most sought-after cultural and commercial hubs for Metaventures, showrooms, and community events.
2. **Miami & Miami Beach Collections:**
   - Players should check the in-game **Collections** tab under Miami before minting or buying on the secondary market to identify Neighborhood, Street, and Ultra-Rare collections.
   - Always verify whether a collection reward has already been claimed on a secondary-market property, though the ongoing **yield boost multiplier** always applies as long as you hold the required number of properties in the collection slot.
3. **Traveling to Miami / Miami Beach:**
   - To reach Miami from another city (such as New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, or San Francisco), head to an **Airport Terminal** in your current city and book a flight to **Miami International Airport (MIA)**, or use the regional train/bus terminal if coming from a connected regional hub.
4. **Miami Events, Hackathons & Community Meetups:**
   - Official Upland live events, city release stress tests, treasure hunt tiers, and seasonal challenges are posted on [https://upland.me/events/](https://upland.me/events/) and announced in the official Upland Discord `#announcements` channel.
   - During city opening events (Vanilla Mode or Standard Mode), properties are released in scheduled neighborhood waves. Check the official event schedule for exact UTC launch windows and FSA allocation percentages.

Document: Upland Official Starter & Gameplay Guide
Source: https://www.upland.me/learn/

## What is Upland & What is UPX Used For?
Upland is a Web3 metaverse and property trading strategy game mapped to the real world.

**What is UPX?**
**UPX** is the primary in-game utility token and currency of Upland. Here is what UPX is used for:
- **Minting & Buying Properties:** Minting unowned virtual properties mapped to real-world addresses and purchasing properties from other players on the secondary marketplace.
- **Earning Passive Yield:** Every property you own generates recurring **UPX yield** (claimable every 3 hours), which can be boosted by placing properties into **Collections**.
- **Travel & Sends:** Paying visitor fees when Sending your Block Explorer to other players' properties, and booking train, bus, or plane tickets between cities (such as traveling to Miami or New York).
- **Treasure Hunting & Events:** Spawning Treasure Hunts and entering official Upland racing or city events.
- **Metaventures:** Buying digital assets (Block Explorers, Legits, Karts, Map Assets, and Structure Ornaments) in player-owned Metaventure shops.
- **Climbing Status Tiers:** Your total UPX balance plus the mint value of your properties determines your **Net Worth in UPX**, unlocking permanent blockchain ownership at **Uplander (10,000 UPX)** and higher tiers (**Pro**, **Director**, **Executive**, **Chief Executive**).

title: Upland Official Starter & Gameplay Guide
text:
Document: Upland Official Starter & Gameplay Guide
Source: https://www.upland.me/learn/

## Player Status Tiers & Net Worth Progression
Every player in Upland has a status level determined by their total **Net Worth in UPX** (the combined value of their UPX balance and the value of properties they own):

1. **Visitor (0 – 9,999 UPX):**
   - Starting tier for new accounts.
   - True ownership on the EOS blockchain is **not yet permanent** while you are a Visitor.
   - **Important Visa Rule:** Visitors must renew their **Upland Visa** at least once every **7 days** by logging in and clicking the Visa renewal button on their profile, or their Visitor account and starter assets will be recycled back to the game.
   - Visitors cannot buy properties from other players on the secondary marketplace until reaching Uplander status.

2. **Uplander (10,000 – 99,999 UPX):**
   - Permanent blockchain account is created automatically upon reaching **10,000 UPX** net worth.
   - **No more Visa renewals required** — your properties are permanently yours on the blockchain.
   - Unlocks the secondary marketplace (buying and selling properties with other players for UPX or USD via Tilia Pay, after completing KYC for USD transactions).

3. **Pro (100,000 – 999,999 UPX):**
   - Unlocks enhanced Block Explorer customization and Pro perks.

4. **Director (1,000,000 – 9,999,999 UPX):**
   - Unlocks custom Block Explorer requests and higher-tier community recognition.

5. **Executive (10,000,000 – 99,999,999 UPX):**
   - Elite tier for major metaverse landowners.

6. **Chief Executive (100,000,000+ UPX):**
   - Highest status tier in Upland.

## Fair Start Act (FSA) Properties
To help new players get started affordably, Upland enforces the **Fair Start Act (FSA)**:
- **Who can mint FSA properties?** Only **Visitors** and **Uplanders** (players with a net worth **under 100,000 UPX**) can mint unowned properties marked with the **FSA** tag. Once a player reaches **Pro status (100,000+ UPX)**, they can no longer mint unowned FSA properties directly from the game.
- **FSA Selling Cooldown / Weekly Limit:** Players who mint FSA properties are subject to a weekly FSA selling limit (typically 2 FSA properties sold or listed on the secondary market per calendar week) while under Pro status, preventing bots or multi-accounting abuse.

text:
Document: Upland Official Starter & Gameplay Guide
Source: https://www.upland.me/learn/

## UPX Earnings, Property Minting & Collections
- **Minting Properties:** Unowned properties appear as **light green** when your Block Explorer passes near them, or **dark green** if they are unowned outside your discovery range (unless unlocked in city releases where non-FSA properties can sometimes be minted without proximity depending on city mechanics).
- **Base UPX Yield:** Every owned property generates passive **UPX yield** (calculated annually as a percentage of the original mint price and paid out continuously, claimable every 3 hours).
- **Collections:** Placing properties into matching **Collections** (such as owning 3 properties on the same street, 3 properties in the same neighborhood, or special city collections) multiplies the passive UPX yield of those properties (e.g., 1.1x to 3.0x boost) and grants a one-time UPX completion reward.
- **Property Colors on the Map:**
  - **Dark Blue:** Properties you own.
  - **Light Blue:** Properties owned by other players (not currently for sale).
  - **Dark Green (with Dollar Sign):** Properties owned by other players that are currently listed for sale on the secondary market.
  - **Light Green:** Unowned properties within your Block Explorer's discovery range that you can mint right now.
  - **Gray:** Unowned properties outside your Block Explorer's range.

Document: Upland Official Starter & Gameplay Guide
Source: https://www.upland.me/learn/

## Sends & Travel Mechanics
- **Block Explorer Movement:** Your Block Explorer wanders randomly across the map and leaves a temporary trail.
- **Sends:** To move your Block Explorer directly to a specific property, you use a **Send** (paper airplane icon).
  - You can hold up to **11 Sends** at a time (plus daily free sends you receive upon login).
  - Additional Sends can be picked up inside **Paper Airplanes** scattered on the map.
  - Sending to another player's property costs a small UPX visitor fee set by the property owner (sending to your own properties is **free** and does not cost UPX, though it consumes 1 Send in standard cities).
- **Inter-City Travel:** To travel between cities (e.g., from San Francisco to Manhattan or Miami), players must take a **Train Terminal**, **Bus Terminal**, **Hyperloop**, or **Airport** flight, which costs UPX and takes real travel time.

Document: Upland Official Starter & Gameplay Guide

## Treasure Hunting
Treasure Hunting allows players to earn UPX and **Sparklet** by triangulation:
- **Standard Tier:** Free to spawn once every 24 hours (or for a small UPX fee on cooldown). One player hunts a private chest in their current city.
- **Limited, Exclusive & Rush Tiers:** Competitive multi-player treasure hunts where players race to follow distance/direction arrows from property to property using Sends before someone else claims the chest.
- **Pro Tip for New Players:** Build a small web of inexpensive properties spread across a single city so you can Send to your own properties for **0 UPX visitor fees** while triangulating treasure arrows.

## Spark & Sparklet (Construction & Manufacturing)
- **What is Sparklet?** Sparklet (formerly Spark; 1 Spark = 1,000 Sparklet) is the resource and token used to build structures (houses, apartments, factories, showrooms) on your properties and to power manufacturing and Metaventure operations.
- **How is Sparklet Used?** Sparklet is **staked** (not burned/consumed) during construction. Once a building finishes construction, your staked Sparklet is immediately returned to your account to be staked on another build or rented/staked elsewhere.
- **How to Get Sparklet:** Daily login bonus streaks (completing a 7-day login streak after verifying your account), Treasure Hunting chests, seasonal events, contests, or acquiring Sparklet tokens.

title: Upland Uppies, Residents, Life & Core Gameplay Guide
text:
Document: Upland Uppies, Residents, Life & Core Gameplay Guide
Source: https://www.upland.me/learn/

## Uppies, Property Sales & Swaps (Resident Ownership)
- **What happens to a resident Uppie when a property is sold or swapped?** **Yes — the Uppie stays with its original owner.** Uppies are tied to the player's account rather than transferring with the property deed, so selling or swapping a property does not transfer the resident Uppie to the buyer.
- **Duty Lock While Assigned:** While an Uppie is actively assigned to a property duty (starting at Level 3 for plant care or future Service Structure automation), that Uppie cannot be merged, sold, or swapped until unassigned.
- **Where to Check Your Uppies:** View all your owned Uppies under the **Uppies** tab in your in-game **Asset Wallet**, and check the top-right corner of a property card for the Uppie resident indicator.
- **Leveling & Merging Uppies:** Uppies can participate in Uppie Quests (all levels) and can be merged up to Level 10; merging two Level 10 Uppies creates a rare **Iconic Parody Uppie (IPU)**.
- **Resident Score & Influence Score:** **Resident Score** tracks how many Uppies live on your properties (updates every 24 hours). **Influence Score** measures how attractive your neighborhoods are to potential residents.

## Life, STEM, Farming, Totems & Troves
- **STEM:** Account-bound, non-tradable Life currency used for plants, farming, animals, and Life gameplay.
- **Troves & Recipes:** Fungible in-game items produced by structures, plants, fishing, animals, and trade routes, combined in **Recipes** at Service Structures to craft higher-order goods requested by Uppies.
- **Totems:** Collectible digital items that generate **STEM** and interact with Life mechanics.

Document: Upland Uppies, Residents, Life & Core Gameplay Guide

## Property Swaps, Metaventures & Tilia (USD)
- **Property Swaps:** Players can swap properties directly with other players; swaps must reflect fair market value and must not be used for asset funneling or collusion.
- **Metaventures:** Player-run shops selling digital assets (Block Explorers, Legits, Karts, Map Assets, Structure Ornaments).
- **Selling for USD (Tilia Pay):** Requires reaching **Uplander** status (10,000+ UPX net worth) and completing **KYC** identity verification through Tilia Pay.
- **Additional Community Reference:** For detailed guides, city calculators, and gameplay walkthroughs, see [Upland Guide](https://upland-guide.com).

# 2020 NFLPA Legits are Back

October 29, 2021

Now that the first batch of[2020 NFLPA Legits](https://www.upland.me/events/the-2020-legits-kickoff-sale) have been delivered, it’s time for them to return to the Upland Store! Registration for the next batch of 2020 NFLPA Legits will begin tomorrow, **Saturday, October 30th, at 8:00 AM PT.** The start of the sale will begin the following morning, **Sunday, October 31st, at 9:00 AM PT. **

**Bundles Overview**

To avoid confusion, packs will now be referred to as bundles, *as they are ****not**** tradable*. Each item within the bundle will be, however, tradable as soon as swapping is enabled. Please see below for the full breakdown of available bundles.

[Click Here to View Inventory of & Probabilities for 2020 Legits.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vS4ay9D_6gCos4mblAX5xJ96QpunEEZ2UwCx9WWg3jQARO4KWEPcejY8ZRPqC-TnpdbgcPwYxWcB61-/pubhtml)

**How to Purchase 2020 Legits**

2020 NFLPA Legits will be sold directly in the Upland store, which is accessible by clicking on the “Get UPX” button at the top right of the screen. While the first batch of 2020 Legits was purchasable exclusively with USD, we are proud to announce that both this sale and future sales will be purchasable in UPX!

Players will have 24 hours to register prior to each sale of 2020 items. Once the sale begins, players will be placed into batches and randomly selected to mint their desired bundles. After all registered participants have had a chance to mint a pack, players will be able to purchase additional bundles after a brief 10 minute cooldown period.

We aim to deliver Legit bundles within 3 business days after purchase; players will be notified upon delivery. Players will also be notified in the event of a delay.

**Future 2020 Legits Sales**

As we prepare for 2021 NFLPA Legits Primary Markets, expect to see 2020 Legits return to the Upland Store on a weekly basis through the remainder of the year. 2020 Legits sales will recur until all items from the 2020 season have been sold or until December 31st.

**An Update on NFT Swaps**

NFT Swapping is actively in development and should be ready for deployment in the near future. Once swapping is enabled, players will be able to exchange any NFT for NFT (excluding properties) inside of the Upland metaverse. Expect to see an NFLPA Legits trading activity shortly following the launch of Swaps.

## How NFLPA Legits Collections Work

The taste of sweet victory for completing a rare Collection is second to none. Here is what you need to know to get started with NFLPA Legits Collections.

‍

### Types of NFLPA Legits

These Collections are made from NFLPA Legits. There are currently two kinds of Legits: Mementos and Essentials.

- Mementos are rare, “1 of 1” Legits that capture real-world data such as player performances for each game. 
- Essentials are commonly available Legits with unlimited minting supply, but are limited by time and/or football season.

**Tip: ***You can read all about Legits and Essentials in the *[NFLPA Legits Guidebook](https://community.upland.me/nflpa-legits-guidebook)*. *

‍

### Completing NFLPA Collections

There are 14 NFLPA Legits Collections, 12 of which are available today for *each of the* *32 football teams. *To complete a Collection, players simply need to move Legits into a team’s corresponding Collection. Please note that UPX earnings for Collections are underway and will be released later this season.

‍

Players are free to purchase Legits at [football stadiums in Upland](https://www.upland.me/events/build-football-stadiums-in-upland-to-win-mementos). Additionally, you can[Swap assets](https://www.upland.me/events/nflpa-legits-swapping-is-now-live) with other players for Legits or buy Legits in [player-owned Fan Shops](https://www.upland.me/events/nflpa-fan-shops).

# A World on the Move: A New Chapter for Terminals and Landmarks

October 14, 2026

Your city already has residents. Soon, **where they travel and what they visit will matter**.

This is a **first look **at a feature we’re developing for **after Troves launches**. It will give residents and Uppies **dynamic daily journeys**, turn **terminals and landmarks** into **active parts **of those journeys, and create concrete **new benefits** for the players who own them.

Share this preview with a friend who helped you build your neighborhood, or someone you’d love to welcome into it. **The next chapter is more exciting when we build the community together.**

### From Residents to Daily Journeys

**Residents** already connect desirable neighborhoods with a population living across Upland’s cities, as reflected in the [Census Score](https://www.upland.me/census). The next step is to **set that population in motion**. Planned **simulated travel** will change from day to day, reflecting where **residents and Uppies are traveling** from and to.

Players will be able to **open a screen and see where residents are traveling and which destinations they visit**. That view will make the rhythm of the world easier to understand: which cities are **sending travelers**, which connections are busy, and which **destinations **are drawing attention.

**Terminals and landmarks** have different jobs in that movement. **Bus, airport, and train terminals connect travel between cities. Landmarks attract visits.** Player activity, including travel through terminals, can help boost that travel, while resident journeys turn landmarks into destinations within a **living daily network**.

### Why Landmark and Terminal Ownership Matters

**Landmark owners benefit by attracting visitors.** The more residents and Uppies visit your landmark, the more **Troves will automatically accumulate** there for you. This gives landmark ownership a new purpose. A landmark is no longer just part of the skyline; it’s a **hub of attraction that generates rewards** based on the activity it draws.

And there’s more on the horizon. **Future Destination Structures** will give players new ways to **increase the attraction** of their cities and neighborhoods, drawing more residents and Uppies to the places they build. These structures will create **new opportunities** for communities to work together to make their neighborhoods **more desirable destinations**. We’ll have much more to share about Destination Structures as development progresses.

**Terminal owners benefit from the traffic moving through their connections.** Alongside the rewards terminals already earn from player travel, increased resident and Uppie traffic will mean **more Troves accumulating** at their terminals for owners to collect.

title: A World on the Move: A New Chapter for Terminals and Landmarks | Upland
text:
Document: A World on the Move: A New Chapter for Terminals and Landmarks | Upland
Source: https://www.upland.me/events/a-world-on-the-move-a-new-chapter-for-terminals-and-landmarks

**Terminal owners benefit from the traffic moving through their connections.** Alongside the rewards terminals already earn from player travel, increased resident and Uppie traffic will mean **more Troves accumulating** at their terminals for owners to collect.

**Automation will make collecting those Troves even easier.** There will be different paths to automating Trove collection across Upland. For example, players will eventually be able to employ an Uppie at a Service Structure or assign an Uppie to a property to automate Trove collection. **Landmarks and terminals will have a similar path to automation**, allowing owners to automatically collect the Troves their locations generate. We’ll share more about these systems and their requirements as we get closer to launch.

**Terminals and landmarks play different but connected roles.** Terminals move travelers between cities, while landmarks give them a reason to visit. Desirable neighborhoods support resident populations, residents take daily journeys through terminals, and landmarks attract visitors. Together, these systems create a living network where **the places players own and the communities they build directly influence the rewards they can earn.**

### Building a More Connected Upland

This is only the beginning of the **destination** story. Future structures, which will be **announced separately**, are planned to help players **build up the attraction **of their cities and neighborhoods, make landmarks even more desirable destinations, and turn terminals into busier connections. Landmarks are already attractions in this system; these future structures will give communities more ways to strengthen the places around them.

**Simulated travel and automation **also lay groundwork for an Upland where **more systems** connect over time, including future gameplay such as** trade routes and fishing**. Those mechanics are not part of this preview, but the movement of residents and Uppies can help make the world around them** feel more alive**.

**This remains a development preview.** Simulated travel and automated Trove accumulation for terminals and landmarks are planned for after the Troves launch, not alongside it, and no release date is being announced today. We’ll share** more mechanics and details** as development progresses.

**Upland is a world we keep building together**. Send this preview to an old Upland friend and invite them back into the conversation. Bring a new friend along, show them your neighborhood, and tell them what you’re excited to build next.

**More visitors. More traffic. More rewards to collect from the places you own.**

# Alameda & Berkeley Collections are Coming in Hot!

January 04, 2022

This **Wednesday, January 5th, at 8:00 AM PT**, we will begin the process of revealing all collections in Alameda & Berkeley (both sold out, and non-sold out). You won't want to miss out on this one!

**Revealing Collections**

The Alameda & Berkeley collections will be revealed through the following process:
‍
‍

Right before the announcement, we will lock any unminted properties in Alameda & Berkeley that are part of collections.
‍
‍

We will then reveal the collection and the collection key (allowing players to confirm the collection on the blockchain).

‍

Unminted properties that match the announced collections, will then be repriced based on the collection level they match. This process of repricing unminted properties-per the publicly available collection data is how properties have been priced in Upland from the initial introduction of collections.

An hour after the announcement, the unminted properties will be unlocked again for minting. As a precaution, make sure to double-check your marketplace properties before the announcement to ensure you don’t sell them below collection-modified value. It may be safer to temporarily remove them from the marketplace before the announcement is made and the collections are revealed.

‍

**What is Vanilla Mode?**

Vanilla mode means that details for the predetermined collections are revealed after a city is released. Details for Collections in cities that are released in Vanilla Mode are minted to the blockchain prior to the release to ensure provable fairness for all players. When collections are revealed, all unminted properties will be repriced to reflect the collection’s impact on property value.

‍

April 11, 2024

We're thrilled to unveil an extraordinary opportunity for designers across the Upland universe: the **Genesis 2024 Design Challenge**! This is not just any competition—it's a chance for you to **unleash your creativity**, **leave your mark** on the vibrant world of Upland, and snag some **fantastic rewards** in the process.

## Unique Structures

The introduction of Bermuda in Upland has ushered in a** revolutionary** feature: For the **first time**, unique buildings can be solely and **exclusively linked** to specific geographic locations, where only buildings of that **particular theme** are allowed to exist. This groundbreaking development allows for a **level of detail** and **customization** previously unseen.

‍

Inspired by this milestone, we're **pushing the boundaries** even further by narrowing our focus to** individual neighborhoods**. Now, not only will buildings be exclusive to particular locations, but we're also introducing the concept of **neighborhood-specific structures**. This means players can **experience and contribute** to the unique architectural identity of each neighborhood, enjoying access to buildings that are uniquely available within these specific areas, further enhancing the **immersive experience** that is Upland.

‍

# Another Community Vote: What Should Happen to This SPARKLET Pool?

October 13, 2026

It’s time for another community vote! Starting **Tuesday, October 13**, you can help decide what should happen to the current pool of spent SPARKLET *(not all SPARKLET)*. The proposal is to **burn this pool and permanently remove it from circulation**. Read the details below, make your voice heard, and share this announcement with friends who care about SPARKLET so they can take part, too.

From **April — October 2026**, approximately **2.9M SPARKLET****was spent on seed generation and Uppie merges**. Based on community feedback, **Upland is recommending** that this **SPARKLET be burned** and permanently removed from circulation.

This vote is focused **only** on what should happen to the approximately **2.9M SPARKLET** generated from these 2026 activities. Upland will hold similar votes for **future SPARKLET spent** through activities.

Existing rewards and incentive pools are **currently well-funded**, and reducing circulating supply **supports the long-term sustainability** of SPARKLET. Now, the community is being asked to **ratify this recommendation**.

### Vote Details

**Voting Opens**: Tuesday, October 13 at 9:00 AM PT

**Voting Closes**: Friday, October 16 at 9:00 AM PT

**Proposal**: Based on previous community feedback, Upland recommends burning the ~**2.9M SPARKLET** spent on seed generation and Uppie merges so far in 2026.

- **Vote YES**: Burn the approximately **2.9M SPARKLET** spent on seed generation and Uppie merges in 2026. This SPARKLET will be permanently removed from circulation.
- **Vote NO**: Do not burn the SPARKLET. If the community votes no, we’ll go back to the drawing board and bring forward new proposals for how this SPARKLET should be handled. **Have a different idea for this specific SPARKLET pool?** Let us know what you would like to see done with it and why. Share your suggestions on our Nolt feedback board: [https://uplandfeedback.nolt.io/2981](https://uplandfeedback.nolt.io/2836)

The vote goes live **Tuesday, October 13 at 9:00 AM PT**. Read the proposal, cast your vote before **Friday, October 16 at 9:00 AM PT**, and help decide what happens to this pool. Bring the conversation to your friends, your neighborhood, and fellow SPARKLET holders, make sure they know when and why to vote!

## Speedway Metaventure Application Details

Before applying for a Speedway Metaventure it is important to understand the requirements a player needs to meet in order to get approved. Two significant requirements are having a specific amount of Spark at the time of application and owning a certain number of properties on the path of their race track. If a player does not meet these requirements for the Speedway, they will not get approved.

‍

### Medium Speedway Structure Application Requirements [UPDATED as of 10.31.23]

In the future, Speedway Structures will be available in a variety of sizes. However, in Phase 1 of Speedway Metaventures, applications will only be open for the Medium Speedway Structure. Please follow our Medium Speedway Structure requirements list closely to maximize your chances of approval. Successful applications will need to meet **all** of the requirements listed below.

**General Requirements**

- The applicant must have a **minimum of 1.0 Spark **at the time the application is submitted. 
- The applicant must own at least **4 Properties** (1 at the starting line and 3 additional properties along the race track). None of these properties can be listed for sale during the review process or your application will be denied. 
- The applicant cannot have multiple active applications with the same starting line address. 
- The applicant must complete KYC identity verification *before* submitting the application.
- The applicant status must be an Uplander or above. 
- The applicant cannot be in Alcatraz.  **Track Name Requirements**

- The applicant’s track name does not contain any hate speech, violence, aggression, profanity, or derogatory/inappropriate text. Additionally, the track name cannot feature the word “Upland” or any other IP.
- The applicant’s track name must be 20 characters or less (including spaces, and no special characters) and unique from other track names and applications.  **Other Requirements**

- The applicant’s track must be located in an existing Upland city.
- The applicant’s track must meet the track length requirements allowed by the Speedway Structure (Minimum track length of 1 mile and a maximum track length of 2.5 miles for the Medium Speedway Structure).
- The applicant’s track must remain as a closed loop. No part of the track may overlap with another part of the track.
- The applicant’s property that will be used for the Speedway Structure needs to be directly adjacent to the starting line of the race track. This property must be big enough to fit the size of the Speedway Structure (Medium Speedway Structure is 37 UP2). The Speedway Structure must also be horizontal to the road. 
- The applicant must agree to pay monthly Venture Dues once they are implemented (Upland’s dynamic model of operating fees for Metaventures).
- The applicant's track path must be one-directional and should not use the same road simultaneously for multiple paths. (Please refer to the images below for examples of allowed and prohibited track paths) ‍

Left image displays allowed track paths and right image displays prohibited track paths. ‍

## How to Map out the Medium Speedway Race Track

Below are detailed steps on how to correctly map out the Speedway for the application.

‍

**Step 1:** Open [Geojson.io](https://geojson.io/) in a web browser.

‍

**Step 2: **Navigate the map view to the location where you want to build your track.

‍

**Step 3:** Use the “Draw Linestring” tool on the right to define a set of points that will be used to create the closed-loop track.

- Click on a location on a street where you would like the starting line for the race track to be placed. *Important Note: Players will need to own an Upland Property at this location to build the Speedway Structure.*
- *Continue clicking along the roads to map out the rest of the race track while ensuring the length of the race track meets the minimum (1 mile) and maximum (2.5 miles) length that is supported by the Speedway Structure. Important Note: Players will need to ensure that the race track runs alongside at least 3 additional properties that they own (the number of additional properties needed is based on the size of the Speedway Structure the player is building).*
- Complete the closed track by double-clicking on the first point. This will link the last point to the first point. ‍

**Step 4: **Choose “Save->GeoJSON” from the top left of the screen to create a .geojson file that will be submitted with the application. **Please rename the geojson file as “Player’s Speedway name”.geojson. **

‍

‍

Check out X1theGamer’s [YouTube video](https://www.youtube.com/watch) on how to map out a Speedway Race Track on [Geojson.io](https://geojson.io/).

In June 2022, Upland released the alpha version of its Developer Tools and announced the Upland Developer’s Program (UDN). Unique in its strategic architectural design from other leading metaverses, Upland does not require developers to build exclusively on Upland using the Upland tech stack. Rather, Upland allows any developer – web2 or web3 – to either connect their existing game/metaspace to the Upland ecosystem, or to build a new experience using their preferred tech-stack. Through the APIs, developers can enjoy the many benefits of being part of the Upland platform including: discoverability, context, virtual locality, the existing economy and payment infrastructure, easy creation of NFTs with blockchain obfuscation, and most importantly - the opportunity to connect to the amazing Upland community.

‍

The ability to onboard existing game and meta-space developers sits at the heart of Upland’s strategy to become the Metaverse Superapp. Executing this strategy, however, requires additional tailored onboarding for devs who are not familiar with Upland or web3 economies. UDNPRO was originally set out to help fill in the gap and serve as a ‘hand holding solution’ for game studios who wish to connect to Upland. Now that the UDNPRO track is in a successful proof of concept (POC) with a number of external dev partners, Upland is opening the program to all UDN members to apply. Applications to this exclusive track will be accepted with the following criteria and considerations:

‍

### UDNPRO Criteria

- Experience is ready to launch - confirmed by the UDN launch committee

- API Integration: the UDN member has fulfilled the minimum integration requirements of incorporating identity and asset escrow integration in their 3rd party apps, demonstrating use of UPX and/or Upland assets within their own experiences

- Presentation of long-term roadmap

- Presentation of benefits to the Upland Community

‍

*Upland will add criteria from time to time as more devs apply to raise the bar and make sure the overall quality of the devs increases to provide better services to the Upland community.*

‍

### UDNPRO Track Benefits

- UPX Grant for purchasing dev-shop real-estate and renting spark.

- Custom structure (building) within Upland

- Upland Partnership manager will accompany the track members in their strategy and operations support.

- Marketing: Upland will promote the Experience to the existing Upland user base through:

- Announcement on Discord and Social Media 
- In-app notifications 
- Newsletter & onboarding emails
- AMA 
- 2 Social Media posts on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, Reddit, and LinkedIn
- Twitter Spaces Live/YouTube (where relevant) - UPX buy-back program for revenue over 20M UPX.

‍

Fill out the [application form](https://forms.clickup.com/10551844/f/a20h4-30880/ZTFMQZ8DX7FDAP08MS) below to apply for UDNPRO.

## Map Asset Factory Application Details

Players must meet all of the requirements below in order to qualify for a Map Asset factory. For this Metaventure type, any size factory will be allowed, but we will not be able to accommodate factory transfers if a player decides they want to upgrade to a larger factory. Please carefully consider which size of factory you want to apply with.

‍

The Upland Team will review all applications and email applicants about the status of their submission within 8 to 12 weeks of submitting their application. If one or more requirements are not met, the process will be delayed further and all players will be notified via email. Please note that submitting multiple applications will result in a longer processing period for the review of your application. We kindly ask for your patience during the review process as it takes time to carefully evaluate each submission.

‍

Are you ready to operate your own Map Asset Factory? Please carefully read all requirements before submitting an application. Remember that **ALL** requirements must be met to be approved.

‍

### Map Asset Factory Application Requirements

Successful applications will meet all the requirements listed below. Please follow our requirements list closely to maximize your chances of approval.

‍

- The applicant must have a fully-constructed Factory structure (Any available factory size) at the time of submission. The Factory property cannot be part of another Metaventure or Metaventure application. Property with factory may not be listed for sale or in offer.
- The applicant must have a minimum of 5 Spark at the time of application. 
- The applicant must be ready to share (via a form) a manufacturing plan, including Map Asset 3D model names and descriptions. This includes the maximum number of mints of each Map Asset and its compatible structures (i.e., type of buildings). More details can be provided at a later date, but we need to understand the plan.
- The applicant must complete KYC identity verification *before* submitting the application.
- The applicant status must be an Uplander or above. 
- The applicant cannot be in Alcatraz. 
- The applicant must agree to pay monthly Venture Dues (Upland’s dynamic model of operating fees for Metaventures). 
- The Metaventure name submitted in the application cannot include the word “Upland” or any other IP.
- The applicant must agree to the capacity limitations per factory size as shown in the chart below. The applicant acknowledges they will not be able to request a factory move later.

‍

text:
Document: Map Asset Factory Applications | Upland
Source: https://www.upland.me/events/apply-for-a-map-asset-factory

If approved for a factory, players will need to submit all Map Asset designs individually for approval. Designs often go through multiple rounds of review before making their way to a player’s factory for production. No specific turnaround time can be guaranteed for a model. The submission link will be shared upon a factory application being approved. When models are approved and before they are made available in a player’s factory, Upland will share the Spark hour cost to produce each asset.

## Map Asset Design Guidelines

‍

Here are some additional guidelines to help model submissions:

‍

- Models must reflect the real world.
- Models should not contain fantasy-based elements.
- Models should mimic the style of structures within the city’s real-world location. 
- The scale, footprint, and height of each model must all match the real world. ‍

Finally, all models must pass Upland’s QA Checklist included in the Submission Form.

title: Map Asset Factory Applications | Upland
text:
Document: Map Asset Factory Applications | Upland
Source: https://www.upland.me/events/apply-for-a-map-asset-factory

## Model Documentation

The following documentation outlines the 3D model specs to follow when creating Map Asset Content for Upland’s Metaverse Super-App. Also, we created a video tutorial for step-by-step instructions.

‍

[Watch the Map Asset Video Tutorial](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PXKD0qR-A4rS0mfFXPIgpmoI1LaicwNW/view)

‍

#### Model Objects

- No Light objects 
- No Camera objects 
- No Empty objects 
- No Animation objects 
- One single mesh

#### Model Positioning

- Origin: [0, 0, 0] 
- Scale: [1, 1, 1] 
- Rotation: [0, 0, 0] 
- Max X Offset (width): 0.01 
- Max Y Offset (height): 0.01 
- Max Z Offset (length): 0.01

#### Model Materials

- Ambient Occlusion must be baked in the main material (Avoid flat color or non shaded areas) 
- Material Alpha (opacity): 1.0 
- Roughness and metallic value could be change if it matches with the characteristics of the model 
- No duplicated materials 
- Texture format: JPEG 
- Texture map must be baked

#### Model UVmaps

- Do not leave unused areas 
- Avoid stretched images 
- If the model is symmetrical or has any repeated mesh or shape, these should be overlapped  
- Include a 10px bleed for the UV islands 
- Any UV island with flat colors/textures should be overlapped 
- Keep UV island size relatively scale according to the actual size of the area (Even texel density)  
- Avoid any stretched or curved sections for cylindrical shapes UV map ‍

### Model Requirements

#### Blender File

- Include all the texture images, fonts, Hdri used (In Blender: file-> External Data-> Automatically pack into .blend)

- Model should only use quads, no n-gons or unnecessary triangles allowed 
- Duplicated materials are not allowed 
- Texture: 2048 x 2048 
- Triangles: < 10,000 ‍

### GLTF Files

#### GLTF characteristics

- File type: GLTF - (GLB not allowed) 
- GTLF jpg texture image should be compressed  
- Transform Y Up

- Mesh should include tangents, normals, UVs  
- Compression level = 6

#### Materials

- Outdoor Decor: 1 Material mandatory

#### Size Limitations

- Outdoor Door: Maximum Height 6 meters  
- Outdoor Door: Maximum Width 17 meters  
- Outdoor Door: Maximum Length 17 meters

#### Other Requirements

- File type: GLTF 
- File size: < 10MB 
- Triangles: < 10,000 max 
- Texture: 1024x1024 (recommended) or 2048x2048 
- Materials: 1 
- Emissive: 0.0 
- Roughness: 1.0 
- Metallic: 0.0

## Racing Legit Shop Application Requirements

- The applicant must complete KYC identity verification before submitting their application.
- The applicant status must be an Uplander or above. 
- The applicant cannot be in Alcatraz. 
- The Racing Legit Shop name submitted in the application must not contain any hate speech, violence, aggression, profanity, or derogatory/inappropriate text. The Racing Legit Shop name also cannot feature the word “Upland” or any other IP. Additionally, the name must be unique from all other Metaventures of the same type (i.e. You can have a Block Explorer Shop named ‘123 Shop’ and a Racing Legit Shop named ‘123 Shop’, but not two Block Explorer Shops named ‘123 Shop’)
- The applicant must be willing to begin paying monthly Venture Dues (Upland’s dynamic model of operating fees) beginning the first week of the month following being launched.
- The applicant must have a fully constructed building on the desired property for the location of the Racing Legit Shop at the time of submitting the application. The following types of buildings are ineligible for this shop type: factories, showrooms, landmarks, and micro houses. 
- The property designated for the Racing Legit Shop cannot be listed on any other Metaventure Application and must not be listed for sale or in any offers.
- The property designated for the Racing Legit Shop cannot be set as a Home Address.
- The applicant must own a minimum of 10 Stock Car Pro Series Legits.  ‍

## New to Spark?

If you’re a new player or are just trying to [figure out what Spark is and what it does](https://www.upland.me/guides-and-tutorials/spark-property-development), no problem! In Upland, we are simulating many aspects of the real world. There is a lot of building in Upland, including Structures on properties, as well as things like cars and Map Assets in factors.

‍

Think of Spark as fuel that keeps [Upland factories](https://www.upland.me/events/new-structure-factories) running and feeds the little llama construction workers building on properties. (Okay, we don’t actually have llama construction workers, but use your imagination!)

‍

Every object that needs to be built or constructed takes a minimum amount of Spark. The more Spark put into building something, the faster that object is built.

‍

For example, if you have a new property, you’ll need Spark to build a structure on the property. You’d do this if you want to have an [Upland Home Address](https://www.upland.me/events/upland-home-addresses-the-beginning-of-community-governance) or [Metaventure Shop](https://www.upland.me/metaventures) on your property.

‍

Unlike UPX, Spark isn’t available at any time. There are certain events – such as Spark Week – when players can earn or buy Spark. If you plan on building in Upland, be sure to grab Spark while you can!

‍

# April Spark Week

April 07, 2022

Get ready to earn Spark! **Starting Monday, April 11th, at 9:00 AM PT**, Spark Week will officially begin, featuring Status-Up Spark Rewards, a Spark Sale in the Upland Store, and a boosted Spark Treasure Tier! This Spark Week will conclude on **Monday, April 18th, at 9:00 AM PT**.

‍

[Looking to learn more about Spark? Click Here!](https://www.upland.me/guides-and-tutorials/spark-property-development)

‍

**Status-Up Spark Rewards‍**

‍

Spark Rewards for leveling up your Upland Status will be enabled starting** Monday, April 11th, at 9:00 AM PT!** This means that players who level up will be entitled to an amount of Spark dependent on their current and new levels. ‍

‍

**Visitor to Uplander:** 0.06 Spark‍

**Uplander to Pro:** 0.12 Spark‍

**Pro to Director:** 0.6 Spark‍

**Director to Executive:** 1.2 Spark‍

**Executive to Chief Executive:** 2.4 Spark‍

‍

***Note:**** Players who level up over multiple tiers will receive the accumulated reward for each previous tier. Status-Up Spark Rewards will be active starting Monday, April 11th, at 9:00 AM PT and will end on Monday, April 18th, at 9:00 AM PT.*

‍

**Changes to Spark Distribution**

To ensure proper distribution of rewards and to limit fraudulent activity, the Upland team will be reviewing all instances of players who leveled up at the conclusion of Spark Week. Once the review has been completed, players will be notified by email and awarded their earned Spark accordingly. This means that Spark will no longer be automatically rewarded upon level up, and will only be dropped at the end of the Status-Up Spark Reward period.

‍

**Changes to Alcatraz**

Upland strives to create a metaverse for all players to enjoy; our expectations are outlined in our [player conduct guide](https://www.upland.me/guides-and-tutorials/player-conduct-alcatraz). As a reminder, those found to have  engaged in fraudulent activity will be sent to Alcatraz near San Francisco for further review. Additionally, we will be updating some of the restrictions for players in Alcatraz. **From now on, players in Alcatraz can no longer mint, buy, or sell properties, earn or stake Spark, or start construction**.

‍

**Spark Sale**

‍Next **Monday, April 11th, at 8:00 AM PT**, registration will open for an opportunity to purchase Spark on **Tuesday, April 12th, at 9:00 AM PT**. Players who register will be selected in batches to purchase varying tiers of Spark.

‍

‍

‍**Boosted Spark Treasures‍**

On **Thursday, April 14th, at 9:00 AM PT**, the Sparked Up Treasure Tier will go live! This special treasure tier will remain active through next weekend and will conclude on **Sunday, April 17th, at 11:59 PM PT**. Compete in a competitive treasure hunt tier with a variety of Spark treasure chests to discover. Spark rewards will be higher than our everyday treasure hunts, so you won’t want to miss out on this opportunity to get bonus Spark rewards.

‍

**Treasures & Reward‍s**

## City Release Details

Opening on **Thursday, January 19 at 9 AM PT **in [Vanilla Mode](https://www.upland.me/guides-and-tutorials/what-is-vanilla-mode), Buenos Aires is the vibrant capital of Argentina and is home to more than 15 million people. Buenos Aires classifies as a medium-sized, medium-priced city according to [Upland’s city tier system](https://www.upland.me/events/city-tiers-update). When Buenos Aires is released, about 17,500 properties in six neighborhoods will be available to all players. More parcels will come later as all 48 neighborhoods eventually open.

One of the launch neighborhoods, Nuñez, is reserved as [Free Start Act (FSA) property](https://www.upland.me/guides-and-tutorials/buying-property). This gives newer players a place to call home while they get comfortable in the metaverse! Overall, about 30% of the properties across all of Buenos Aires are reserved as FSA.

### City Information

- **Send Fees (Lo/Hi/Default): **10/50/20
- **Airport:** Yes
- **Train Terminal: **Yes (from airport to city)
- **Collections:** 11-17
- **Launch properties: **17,500
- **Total neighborhoods: **48
- **FSA Allocation:** 30%
- **Treasure Hunt Tier: **4
- **Future Expansions: **Yes

### Launch Neighborhoods

- Boca
- Nuñez (FSA Neighborhood)
- Puerto Madero
- Recoleta
- Retiro
- San Telmo ‍

## Fun Facts About Buenos Aires

Get ready to have your mind blown as we dive into the wild world of Buenos Aires and discover some fun facts that make this city a must-see!

‍

- Home to two of the most successful soccer clubs in Argentina, Buenos Aires is the site of the famed "Superclásico" between Club Atlético Boca Juniors and Club Atlético River Plate. This fierce rivalry has a large and passionate fan base, and the teams have won numerous domestic and international titles. Whenever these two rivals clash, the match is so intense and emotional that it brings the city to a standstill, captivating viewers worldwide.
- This city is the birthplace of tango, the scorching hot and tantalizing dance that emerged from the smoky streets in the late 19th century. But this isn't just any ordinary dance, oh no. The tango is a worldwide symbol of romance and passion that will set your heart ablaze and leave you breathless. Don’t forget to pack your bags with your dancing shoes, because Buenos Aires is about to show you a whole new level of heat!
- The city has more bookstores per capita than any other city in the world, making it a paradise for book lovers. 
- The Obelisco de Buenos Aires is an iconic national monument of Argentina and the pride of Buenos Aires! Located in the Plaza de la República, it was built in 1936 to mark the city's 400th anniversary.
- The city is also known for its colorful street art in many neighborhoods, including La Boca and Palermo’s vibrant murals and graffiti.

¡Prepárate para sumergirnos en el salvaje mundo de Buenos Aires y descubrir algunos datos curiosos que hacen de esta ciudad una visita imperdible!

‍

- El hogar de dos de los clubes de fútbol más laureados de Argentina, Buenos Aires es el local del famoso "Superclásico" entre el Club Atlético Boca Juniors y el Club Atlético River Plate. Esta feroz rivalidad cuenta con una gran y apasionada afición. Los dos equipos han ganado títulos nacionales e internacionales. Cada vez que estos dos rivales se enfrentan, el partido es tan intenso y emotivo que paraliza la ciudad, cautivando a espectadores de todo el mundo.
- Esta ciudad es el origen del tango, el ardiente y provocativo baile que surgió de sus calles llenas de humo a finales del siglo XIX. Pero no se trata de un baile cualquiera, oh no. El tango es un símbolo mundial de romanticismo y pasión que te encenderá el corazón y te dejará sin aliento. No olvide hacer las maletas con sus zapatos de baile, porque Buenos Aires está a punto de mostrarle un nuevo nivel de calor.
- La ciudad tiene más librerías per cápita que cualquier otra ciudad del mundo, lo que la convierte en un paraíso para los amantes de los libros.
- El Obelisco de Buenos Aires es un monumento nacional emblemático de Argentina y un ícono de Buenos Aires. Situado en la Plaza de la República, donde confluyen las avenidas Corrientes y 9 de Julio, fue construido en 1936 para conmemorar el 400 aniversario de la ciudad.
- La ciudad también es conocida por su colorido arte callejero, con vibrantes murales y grafitis en muchos barrios, como La Boca y Palermo.

# Arlington Evolution Steps Up To The Plate With Sandlot Sporting Goods

October 23, 2026

City Evolution returns to Arlington with limited property access, an existing Limited Collection target, and a signature modular structure built around the city’s baseball spirit. **East Coast Modular Apartments: Sandlot Sporting Goods** brings a hometown sporting-goods theme to the modular lineup, giving Arlington builders a fresh way to add character to familiar city blocks.

With **100 Standard Packs** and **300 Deluxe Packs** available, this release is focused on building deeper within Arlington’s existing footprint. Deluxe Packs carry a **30% pack-level chance** of containing a property from the existing **Central Limited Collection** and include the signature Sandlot Sporting Goods structure.

### Neighborhoods

No new Arlington neighborhoods are opening with this release. Properties in both pack tiers come from the city’s existing footprint, keeping the focus on adding depth to established blocks rather than unlocking new territory.

### Collections

No new Collection is being introduced. The **Central Limited Collection** is already published and remains the Collection target for the **Arlington Deluxe Pack’s 30% pack-level chance**.

The **Arlington Standard Pack** does not include a Collection-property chance in this release. A Collection property is not guaranteed in a Deluxe Pack.

### Details

Both **Arlington Evolution Packs** will be available in limited quantities in the Upland Store.

**Registration Opens:** Friday, October 23 at 9 AM PT
**Sale Starts:** Saturday, October 24 at 9 AM PT
**Sale Ends:** Friday, October 30 at 9 AM PT

### Arlington Standard Pack

Includes one random property in Arlington with a **guaranteed minimum property UPX value of 10,000 UPX**.

**Price:** 10,000 UPX
**Quantity:** 100 packs
**Guaranteed Minimum Property UPX Value:** 10,000 UPX
**Collection Property Chance:** Not included in this release

### Arlington Deluxe Pack

Includes two random properties in Arlington with a **guaranteed combined minimum property UPX value of 42,000 UPX**, a **30% pack-level chance** of receiving a property from the existing **Central Limited Collection**, and the **East Coast Modular Apartments: Sandlot Sporting Goods** structure.

For players building Arlington blocks with more personality, the Deluxe Pack brings together two properties, this release’s Collection-property opportunity, and a signature modular structure with unmistakable baseball character.

**Price:** $20 on web / $28.49 on mobile
**Quantity:** 300 packs
**Guaranteed Minimum Property UPX Value:** 42,000 UPX combined
**Collection Property Chance:** 30% per pack

**East Coast Modular Apartments: Sandlot Sporting Goods** brings ballpark spirit to the block. Picture **Uppies debating yesterday’s game, swapping baseball stories, and showing off a well-worn glove** as they make their way through the neighborhood. Its baseball sporting-goods theme gives Arlington builders a lively, lived-in piece of local character for their modular streetscapes.

Like other modular structures, it supports flexible building and long-term customization, giving players more ways to develop city blocks while preserving a strong sense of place and regional identity.

This signature structure is **exclusive to the Arlington Deluxe Pack in this release**.

# Audio Engineering Challenge

March 29, 2022

[4/1/2022 UPDATE]

Thank you to everyone who submitted entries for the Audio Engineering Challenge. We had so many great entries and picking our 3 favorites was not easy. Congratulations to each of our winners and check out their submissions below! In no particular order, our winners are…

- [Bleurain](https://youtu.be/8GoIIpm657Y)
- [JOESTOCKK](https://youtu.be/sVXJ2oXxO2Q)
- [CPTOJRBZ](https://youtu.be/XtLycBtW8Es) ‍

--

‍

If a car drives by in Upland and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound? While the physics of the Upland metaverse are yet to be understood, one thing we do know is that we need your help in putting new sounds to our cars! You have seen the teaser (if not, check it out [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch)) and you have heard us talk about how we are getting ready for cars, but there is still more to do!

‍

The sounds of racing in our teaser were phenomenal, but we want a more personal touch. If you are up for a challenge, we dare you to take our cars teaser and add your own sounds to it.

‍

**Challenge & Rewards**

To join the challenge, please submit a video of your car sounds over the cars teaser video (download [here](https://community.upland.me/audio-engineering-challenge)). You have about 30 seconds to show us what you can do. After submissions have closed, our team will then our pick our 3 favorites entries, and the winning submissions will earn **50k UPX;** they may also be potentially be used as the sound for a future MMotors vehicle! There are a few restrictions, sounds *must *be created using only your voice (with minimal audio editing) and you must appear on camera.

‍

To help spur your creativity and provide an example of what we are looking for, check out this sample featuring Upland team members X1theGamer and General Mort.

‍

‍

**Submission Details**

Please upload your submission to Youtube and share the link with us [here](https://community.upland.me/audio-engineering-challenge). Please make sure that you have the correct privacy settings and that your video is available to be viewed.  If we cannot view your video, your submission will be disqualified. Submissions are due by **Thursday, March 31st at 11:59 PM PT**.

‍

We look forward to reviewing your submissions and continuing to build the future of cars with you!

‍

## Status-Up Spark Rewards

One of the best ways to earn extra (free!) Spark is to level up your Upland Status during Spark Week. These Spark rewards are greater than the standard Spark earned when leveling up, so if you’re close to a level up, now is the time to go for it!

‍

Status-Up Spark Rewards run from **Monday, August 15th at 9:00 AM PT** to **Monday, August 22nd at 9:00 AM PT**. The amount of Spark rewarded differs for each level. Here’s a breakdown:

‍

- **Visitor to Uplander:** 0.06 Spark‍
- **Uplander to Pro:** 0.12 Spark‍
- **Pro to Director:** 0.6 Spark‍
- **Director to Executive:** 1.2 Spark‍
- **Executive to Chief Executive:** 2.4 Spark‍ ‍

Jumping up in status comes with plenty of perks. To catch up on the benefits for each level, check out the [guide on Upland Status](https://www.upland.me/guides-and-tutorials/understanding-upland-status).

title: August Spark Week | Upland
text:
Document: August Spark Week | Upland

## Sparked Up Treasure Hunt Tier

[Treasure Hunting](https://www.upland.me/how-to-guide/treasure-hunts) and Spark go together like peanut butter and jelly. In this special Sparked-Up Treasure Hunt Tier, players scour cities in search of various Spark chests. The Sparked-Up Competitive Treasure Hunts run from **Thursday, August 18th at 9:00 AM PT** to **Sunday, August 21st at 11:59 PM PT**.

‍

### Treasures and Rewards

There are four types of chests: Grey, Blue, Metal, and Spark. Each chest has different rewards depending on a city’s [Treasure Hunting Tier](https://www.upland.me/events/treasure-hunting-updates-new-tiers-rewards). Check out our graphic below for specific rewards. And for the Spark Week veterans out there, please note that the prize payouts have been changed as we continue to monitor reward distribution.

***Note:**** There are currently no Tier 3 Treasure Hunting cities in Upland.*

‍

### Reward Distribution

Expect to see Spark deposited into your account a day or two after the competitive tier has concluded. Once the Sparked Up Tier comes to an end, we will collect the results and distribute Spark rewards to all players who discovered one of the treasures above. Winners will receive an email notifying them that their rewards are now available.

‍

### Riot Mode and Decreased Spawn Rates

As we announced in last month’s Spark Week post, we’ve removed Riot Mode for the Sparked Up Tier to help balance Spark distribution. This is still in effect, meaning that players will not receive Riot Mode multiplier bonuses for Spark-Up Treasures even if Riot Mode is active.

‍

In addition, we have decreased the spawn rate and tweaked reward values for Sparked Up Treasures, further reducing the amount of Spark that can be earned. Despite the removal of Riot Mode, we felt that Spark was still being distributed a bit too freely (there are some really good Treasure Hunters out there), and as a result we are looking to curb rewards a bit.

‍

We will continue to monitor the impact of these changes and adjust them as necessary.

‍

# Collector Score is Back For Harvest Season

October 05, 2026

Every collection has a few favorites. The Block Explorer you had to have. The pass that completed your set. The badge you worked all season to earn. This Harvest, those pieces could help put your name among Upland’s top collectors.

The **Harvest Season 2026 Collector Score Challenge** is back, with **UPX, collector badges, and an exclusive Block Explorer** waiting at the finish line. Build your seasonal collection, follow the standings, and see how far you can climb.

### Meet The Gilded Acorn ‘26

A little collector with a very big find. **The Gilded Acorn **’26 is a storybook squirrel with a leaf-lined satchel, proudly holding a golden acorn almost as big as its head. Warm autumn colors and a tiny pile of collected treasures bring the spirit of **Storybook Harvest** to this season’s collector reward.

Finish in the **top 25** of the Harvest Collector Score Challenge to earn **The Gilded Acorn ’26 Block Explorer**. It is a keepsake for the collectors who turn this season’s discoveries into a collection worth celebrating.

**1st–3rd Place**

- 200,000 UPX each
- Harvest Season Collector Badge
- The Gilded Acorn ’26 Block Explorer **4th–10th Place**

- 50,000 UPX each
- The Gilded Acorn ’26 Block Explorer **11th–25th Place**

- The Gilded Acorn ’26 Block Explorer

### Make Every Find Count

The seasonal challenge focuses on **eligible collectibles released during Harvest Season 2026**, not the size of your entire collection. Your Block Explorers, Season and City Passes, and Badges all have a part to play.

Keep an eye on new seasonal releases, pursue the badges you want to earn, and check your **Harvest seasonal ranking** as your collection grows. The All-Time leaderboard celebrates your wider collection, but this challenge’s prizes are decided by your Harvest score.

There is a golden acorn waiting at the end of this story. Give it a place in yours.

[Check the Collector Score leaderboard here](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/d8cba679-777c-4fb9-9326-9596b30a44c4/page/45HeC)

#### *Here Are the Collector Score Rules*

*Already familiar with Collector Score? You have the season’s reward details above. Read on for a refresher before you start your Harvest collection.*

- ***Eligible categories:**** Block Explorers, Season Passes, City Passes, and Badges released during Harvest Season 2026.*
- ***Score weighting:**** Block Explorers contribute 30%, Season and City Passes 20%, and Badges 50%.*
- ***Burned assets:**** Burned items do not count toward Collector Score. Season Pass activation and Fusion qualification are separate mechanics; qualifying for those benefits does not mean a burned pass still contributes to your Collector Score.*
- ***Seasonal standings:**** Harvest challenge rewards are based on the final Harvest seasonal standings, not the Overall Score ranking.*
- ***Ties:**** If players finish with the same score, the player who reached that score first ranks higher.*
- ***Leaderboard updates:**** The external leaderboard updates every 12 hours, so changes may not appear immediately.*

# From Factory to Showroom | Upland

**Source:** https://www.upland.me/events/from-factory-to-showroom
# From Factory to Showroom

August 13, 2026

Property decor is a** central gameplay loop **in Upland, bringing more ownership, connectivity, and uniqueness to the world. **Our goal **is to make that experience** accessible** to more property owners while continuing to **expand** the ways players can customize and bring their properties to life.

**We started** by moving foundational decor into the Upland Store, giving more players an easy way to begin decorating. Since then, **we’ve continued** adding new items each week and will keep building out the catalog over time to give players more options. This week, **we also****added** grass to the Store, making **another foundational piece** of property customization **easier **to access.

Now, we’re **working on the next part** of that experience: making **UGC production easier** to manage.

We’re previewing **automatic factory-to-showroom placement**, an upcoming workflow that will let creators choose a destination showroom when they begin manufacturing. As each item is completed, it **will be placed **on the selected showroom property **automatically**. We expect this feature to arrive **before Harvest Season**.

That means **fewer repetitive steps**, less time moving finished products by hand, and **more time **for creators to **design**, **stock **their showrooms, and** build **their businesses.

### From Factory to Showroom, Automatically

Today, creators need to manually place completed products at their showrooms after manufacturing them. With the **new workflow**, that destination will be set when the item is added to the factory queue.

After choosing an item to manufacture, creators will select **where the finished products should go**. They’ll see a list of their owned properties that have showrooms and choose the appropriate destination.

From there, the workflow depends on whether that showroom already has an inventory lot:

- **If an inventory lot already exists:** select the showroom and start the production queue.
- **If an inventory lot still needs to be created:** choose **Add Lot** to open the Property Editor, draw the inventory lot, then return to select the showroom as the destination. Once the destination is set and production begins, **completed items will be placed on that showroom property automatically**.

That means the placement setup happens **once at the start of the production** run, rather than requiring creators to move each finished item manually afterward.

### Less Busywork, More Building

Property decor is becoming a more central part of the Upland experience, and UGC is a key part of that loop.

Automatic factory-to-showroom placement is currently in development and is planned to arrive **before harvest season**.

By removing a repetitive inventory step, creators can spend less time managing finished products and more time designing, stocking showrooms, and building their businesses.

As property decor grows, we want the systems behind it to make creating, selling, and decorating easier for everyone.

# Get Ready: Troves, Uppie Property Assignment, and Upland’s Biggest Uppie Drop Yet

July 28, 2026

The countdown is on!

Sizzle Season is almost here, and with it comes a major step forward for Upland. For the first time, we’re sharing **confirmed launch windows** for two highly anticipated features: **Uppie property assignment** and the full launch of **Troves, Trove Banking, and Progression**.

These updates are designed to work together. Uppies will begin supporting the properties you develop, while Troves will connect activity across properties, structures, plants, service structures, and neighborhoods. It all builds on the foundation that has always defined Upland: **property development, property trading, and true digital ownership**.

Here are the dates to know:

- **Uppie property assignment:** Launching during Sizzle Season, which runs from August 1 through September 15, 2026
- **Troves, Banking, and Progression:** Launching before Harvest Season begins on October 1, 2026
- **Uppie bundle registration:** July 28 at 9:00 AM PT
- **Uppie bundle sale:** July 29 at 9:00 AM PT

### Troves Are Coming Before Harvest Season

That’s right: **Troves are scheduled to go live before Harvest Season begins on October 1**.

The initial release will focus on three connected pillars:

- **Collect.** Discover and collect Troves through gameplay across Upland, both by collecting them from plants and structures and by generating them through recipes. ​
- **Bank.** Permanently commit selected Troves to your collection, display them in your Trove Vault, and advance through Trove Banking levels.
- **Progress.** Build your new Upland Progression level by banking Troves, developing your property portfolio, completing objectives, and advancing your existing Upland status.

Together, these systems will give players** more ways** to pursue goals, preserve accomplishments, earn rewards, and demonstrate their progress throughout Upland. Additional features connected to Troves will arrive in** later releases**, but this first launch **establishes the foundation** for the larger system ahead.

Troves are important because they help turn individual Upland features into a **connected gameplay loop**. The properties you own, the structures you build, the plants you care for, and the neighborhoods you help develop can all contribute to what you collect and how you progress.

Ownership is the starting point. **Development determines what you do with it.**

### Uppies Are Moving Onto Properties During Sizzle Season

Before Troves arrive, another major piece of the system will fall into place.

During **Sizzle Season, **players will gain the ability to **assign Uppies to their properties**.

At launch, **Level 3 and higher Uppies** will be eligible for property assignment. Once assigned, an Uppie will act as a caretaker by handling petting for the plants on that property, **helping maintain their wellbeing**. Players will still be responsible for feeding their plants, but their assigned Uppie will take care of ongoing petting.

This is the beginning of meaningful, property-level **Uppie utility**.

In other words, the Uppies you collect will not simply sit in your inventory. They are becoming **active participants** in the world **you are building**.

Where you** assign** them will matter. What **you build** on that property will matter. How **you develop** your neighborhood will matter.

### Everything Comes Back to Properties

Troves, Banking, Progression, Uppies, Life, plants, service structures, and future systems are not being built as isolated features. They are being **designed to reinforce one another**, with properties at the center.

That is the larger vision taking shape.

You **own** and trade properties. You **decide** what to build on them. Development creates new possibilities. Uppies support the properties you choose to prioritize. Troves transform activity into collection, strategy, and progression. Those systems then create more reasons to build, improve, specialize, and** participate in the broader Upland economy**.

Upland’s core remains the same: **buy, trade, build, and develop**. These updates make every part of that loop **more connected**, giving greater utility and meaning to the properties you own and the choices you make.

# Grass Moves to the Store & Sod Arrives with a Burn Event!

August 03, 2026

***Editor’s Note:**** We’ve updated the wording for clarity: players will receive ****425 UPX for each Grass Seed Pack burned**** during the event.*

Next week we’re making **the biggest change to grass** since seeds launched. **Grass is moving out of nurseries and into the store** at a **price built for everyone**, we’re **introducing sod** for instant lawns, and before any of it goes live, we’re running a** burn event that pays every grass seed holder** above today’s market. Here’s the quick rundown:

- **Starting August 3rd, **grass seeds will no longer be generated in nurseries
- **Grass seeds are moving from nurseries to the Upland store**, priced at 75 UPX per seed
- **Sod is here**: a brand new way to get a fully grown lawn instantly, no waiting
- **Burn event, Aug 3rd to Aug 10th**: burn any grass seed pack to receive **425 UPX each**, above today’s market floor
- **Every player who burns at least one pack earns the Fresh Cut Badge**, available only during this event, then gone for good

### Why grass is moving

Grass was **designed to be the most common seed** in Upland and **the easiest way to decorate **your property. Right now it’s trading at 350–400 UPX for a single square. That’s not what the foundation of every property should cost, so we’re fixing it, **items meant for everyone should be priced and available for everyone**.

**Grass is the only plant making this move.** We don’t foresee any other seeds leaving nurseries. **Trees, flowers, and everything else stay in nurseries** where rarity belongs. And we expect accessible grass to **grow the whole system**: more players starting lawns means **more players discovering planting**, and more players heading to nurseries for everything else.

### The New Line Up

Starting **Monday, August 10 at 9am PT**, the store will carry:

- **Grass Seed Pack**: 1 seed, 75 UPX
- **Lawn Starter Pack**: 4 seeds, 275 UPX
- **Yard Builder Pack**: 16 seeds, 1,000 UPX
- **2x2 Sod Twin Pack**: 2 fully mature 2x2 patches, $1
- **4x4 Sod Twin Pack**: 2 fully mature 4x4 patches, $3

### What’s sod?

Sod is **fully grown grass**, ready the moment you place it.

But it’s more than that: sod comes in** larger patches you place as one piece**, covering a **2x2 or 4x4 area **in a single placement instead of planting seeds square by square.

Seeds are the value option: plant them one at a time, grow them, watch your lawn come in. **Sod is the convenience option**: one placement, instant finished lawn. Same grass, two ways to get there.

*The image above shows both sod sizes for comparison.*

### The Burn Event

### The Burn Event

We recognize that players holding grass seed packs generated with Sparklet could have been selling them, so** we’re compensating those players** before the store opens.

From **Monday, August 3rd at 9am PT to Monday, August 10th at 9am PT**, burn any grass seed pack to receive **425 UPX each**.

For reference: at the time of this announcement, the marketplace floor for a grass seed pack is 350–400 UPX. The burn pays above today’s market and more than five times the new store price. If you’re holding grass seeds, this is the window to cash out on top.

*Grass Seed marketplace floor prices as of Monday, August 3, 2026.*

### The Fresh Cut Badge

Burn **at least one grass seed pack **during the event and you earn the **Fresh Cut Badge**, a permanent badge available only during this event. Once the burn closes, it’s gone for good.

Burn payouts are processed **after the event closes**. All UPX will be dropped to your account within 48 hours of the event closing, alongside your **Fresh Cut Badge**. Your burns are tracked from the moment you make them, so burn any time during the window and your full payout arrives on payout day. Players can track their burns on a leaderboard that is [now live here](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/973aa668-4016-4a29-a52a-81b1fb2a0506).

### The Bigger Picture

Every change here points in the same direction: the things that should be common in Upland are **becoming truly accessible**, and the things that should be rare** stay special**. Grass at 75 UPX means every player can lay down a lawn on day one. Sod means finishing it takes seconds instead of days. And **nurseries stay the home of the hunt**, where trees, flowers, and the rarest seeds are still earned, not bought.

We think lawns are about to become** one of the most common sights** in Upland, and that’s exactly the point. More green on the streets, more players planting, more neighborhoods that look lived-in.

So **burn your seeds**, claim your** Fresh Cut Badge**, and set a reminder for August 10. Upland is about to get a fresh cut of grass!

# Harvest 2026 Championship Racing: Six Races. Every Point Counts.

October 02, 2026

Six weeks of racing. Twelve spots on the road to Genesis Week. One Harvest champion crowned on points.

**Harvest 2026 Championship Racing** is bringing a new reason to keep your foot on the gas. This season, we’re replacing the standalone Season Championship Final with a **sixth points-scoring race**, giving racers another full week to climb the standings, close the gap, and fight for a place in the **top 12**.

The **Harvest 2026 Championship Racing Pass is live in the Upland Store now** and remains available until **Wednesday, October 7 at 9 AM PT**. Get your pass, get your setup ready, and make every week count.

### Six Races to Make Your Move

Your season will no longer come down to a separate championship final. Instead, **the racer with the most season points after all six weeks will be crowned the Harvest champion**.

That means Week 6 is another opportunity to earn points, not a race reserved for racers who have already qualified. A rough opening week does not end your run. Keep racing, keep improving, and use every opportunity to move up the leaderboard.

There is more than a title on the line, too. **The top 12 racers at the end of Harvest will qualify for the Harvest semifinal during Genesis Week 2027**, held on the **Paris Monument track**. Whether you are chasing first place or fighting your way into the **top 12**, you have six weeks to make your move.

**There is no standalone Season Championship Final during Harvest.** The weekly competition format stays the same, including its qualifying rounds, semifinal heats, and final heat. What changes is how the season champion is decided and when the season’s **top 12** move on.

### The Road to Genesis Week

The season earns you your place. **Genesis Week is where you race for the Grand Final.**

During Genesis Week, racers will compete in **each seasonal semifinal they have qualified for**. Qualifying across multiple seasons gives you more opportunities to race and accumulate points during Genesis Week.

There will be **six races in total during Genesis Week, including the Grand Final**. Points earned in the Genesis Week semifinals will determine the **top six racers who advance to the Grand Final**.

For Harvest, the route is clear: **race all six weeks, finish in the top 12, and earn your place in the Paris semifinal at Genesis Week**. Then compete for the points that can put you on the final starting grid.

### Week 5 Is Bonus Points Week

**Week 5 remains Bonus Points Week**, giving racers another opportunity to close the gap, climb the standings, or defend their position.

# Harvest Finds, Vintage Treasures, and a Savory Stop

October 07, 2026

Another chapter of **Storybook Harvest** is ready for your neighborhood. This week’s four new **Service Structures** bring farm-market charm, vintage toys, curious finds, and a savory snack stop to your streets. Invite a friend back to explore your autumn neighborhood, or introduce someone new to the community you are building.

These **Service Structures** will be available starting **Wednesday, October 7 at 9 AM PT** for players with **Uplander status** and above. No registration is required. Once a player purchases one, it will disappear from that player’s store.
