# Harvest Season 2026: Fresh Missions, New Discoveries

October 01, 2026

A new season is taking root in Upland. **Harvest Gamified Earnings missions begin Tuesday, October 6**, bringing a simpler seasonal chase: **10 missions, all weekly, with no season-long missions.** Jump into each week’s challenges, work toward next season’s UPX earnings, and get ready for something new to collect with **Troves expected to arrive during October**.

From your first paid send to your final completed mission, Harvest is about getting out into Upland and making progress. Here is what is changing, what is staying, and how to start your run.

### Week 1: Send and Celebrate (October 6–13)

The opening drop runs from **Tuesday, October 6 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, October 13 at 7 AM PT**.

- **Sweat:** Do 10 paid sends to 10 unique properties in Upland.
- **Build:** Decorate 5 structures on 5 different properties with Harvest Season Ornaments. Get moving, give your properties their seasonal look, and put your first two missions on the board. For the Build mission, remember that the five decorated structures must be on **five different properties**.

### Week 2: Building Momentum (Oct 13-20)

This week's mission runs from **Tuesday, October 13 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, October 20 at 7 AM PT**.

- **Build:** Begin construction on 3 different Living Structures on 3 different properties anywhere in Upland.

Break ground, expand your neighborhood, and put this week's Build mission on the board.

### Week 3: Race & Grow (Oct 20-27)

This week's missions run from **Tuesday, October 20 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, October 27 at 7 AM PT**.

- **Sweat:** Complete 5 public multiplayer Kart races.

- **Build:** Plant 3 trees or 3 flowers on any property you own.

Hit the track, get your hands dirty, and put both missions on the board this week!

### Week 4: Istanbul Bound (Oct 27 - Nov 3)

This week's missions run from **Tuesday, October 27 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, November 3 at 7 AM PT**.

- **Sweat:** Travel to Istanbul.

- **Build:** Mint 1 property in Istanbul.

Pack your bags, explore Upland's newest city, and stake your claim in Istanbul to complete both missions!

### Week 5: Build & Explore (Nov 3 - Nov 10)

This week's missions run from **Tuesday, November 3 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, November 10 at 7 AM PT**.

- **Build:** Participate in 2 fulfilled Construction Hub contracts involving 2 different structure models. You can participate as the requester, builder, or a combination of both. Cemeteries do not count.
- **Sweat:** Visit 5 different cities using public or private transportation.
Put your construction skills to work, hit the road, and complete both missions to keep your Harvest Gamified Earnings rolling!

### Week 6: Treasure Rush (Nov 10-17)

This week's mission runs from **Tuesday, November 10 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, November 17 at 7 AM PT**.

### What’s Changing This Harvest

This season, **all 10 missions are weekly missions**, spread across six mission windows. The **season-long Influence Score and Residents missions** are not returning for Harvest. Your Gamified Earnings mission progress will come from completing the challenges revealed each week.

The mission schedule starts on **Tuesday, October 6**, rather than on the season’s October 1 opening day. The final mission window closes on **Tuesday, November 17 at 7 AM PT**.

The format is changing, but the headline earnings targets stay the same: **complete any 5 missions for 14.7% annual UPX earnings, or all 10 for the maximum 15.2%** for the following season.

### Sweat or Build. Pick Your Path.

Every mission this season is labeled** Sweat or Build**. Sweat missions are experiences, racing, treasure hunting, exploring the map. Build missions are about building in Upland, construction, minting, decorating. Two ways to play Harvest Season.

Choose the missions that fit **how you enjoy Upland**, or take on the full set and go for the sweep.

### A Fresh Drop Every Tuesday

One or two new missions drop **every Tuesday at 9 AM PT**, starting October 6. Each week’s completion deadline is the **following Tuesday at 7 AM PT**.

Only the current week’s missions can be completed, and missed missions cannot be recovered. The remaining missions will stay a mystery until their weekly reveal, so check back each Tuesday for your next challenge.

**Mission period:** October 6 through November 17, 2026. The final weekly window runs November 10–17 and keeps its full Tuesday-to-Tuesday schedule.

### Show Up or Go for the Sweep

- Complete **any 5 of the 10 missions** for **14.7% annual UPX earnings** in the following season.
- Complete **all 10 missions** for the maximum **15.2% annual UPX earnings** in the following season. You do not have to complete every mission to reach the five-mission tier. Pick your opportunities, finish them within their weekly windows, and keep building your total.

### Complete the Harvest Run

Going for every mission? There is a seasonal finish line to chase beyond the earnings tiers.

- **Completionist Badge: **The **Completionist Badge**, an **exclusive reward** for players who complete all **gamified earnings missions in a season**.
- This badge is the ultimate mark of **dedication and consistency**. It’s not just about earnings, it’s a statement. Wear it with pride and show the community that you don’t just play the game,** you complete it.**
- **Completionist Block Explorer:** Introducing **The Final Chapter **’26, A storybook Block Explorer inspired celebrating the theme of Harvest season. The Final Chapter ’26 **honors the most dedicated players** who completed **every Gamified Earnings mission** across Harvest Season 2026.

- This badge is the ultimate mark of **dedication and consistency**. It’s not just about earnings, it’s a statement. Wear it with pride and show the community that you don’t just play the game,** you complete it.**
- **Completionist Block Explorer:** Introducing **The Final Chapter **’26, A storybook Block Explorer inspired celebrating the theme of Harvest season. The Final Chapter ’26 **honors the most dedicated players** who completed **every Gamified Earnings mission** across Harvest Season 2026.

With an **activated Harvest Season Pass**, completionists can qualify for the seasonal **Completionist Block Explorer**. The pass’s **Wildcard Token** automatically covers exactly one missed weekly mission at the end of the season for Block Explorer eligibility.

The Wildcard applies to **Completionist Block Explorer eligibility only**. It does not add a completed mission to your earnings total: you must directly complete five missions to reach 14.7%, and all ten to reach 15.2%.

### A New Season of Trove Discoveries

Weekly missions are only part of what is ahead. **Troves are expected to launch during October**, bringing a new collecting and progression experience to Upland.

The team is preparing **over 500 Troves reaching eight levels deep**, alongside a **brand-new progression system**. That means more discoveries to pursue and a bigger collection to explore as Harvest unfolds.

Make your properties feel like Harvest, take on each week’s missions, and get ready to begin your Trove collection. The exact Troves launch date will be shared once confirmed. **Troves are a separate gameplay release**, not a reward for completing these missions.

Follow Upland on **Discord and X** for each Tuesday’s mission reveal and the latest Troves launch news. Your Harvest run starts October 6. Let’s make it count.

### How Gamified Earnings Work

Already familiar with Gamified Earnings? You have everything you need above. Here is the full earnings breakdown for players who want a refresher.

Gamified Earnings are **forward-looking**: missions completed during Harvest determine your annual UPX earning rate for the following season, not the rate you receive during Harvest itself.

- **1 mission completed (1.2x):** 5.88% annual UPX earnings
- **2 missions completed (1.5x):** 7.35% annual UPX earnings
- **3 missions completed (2x):** 9.8% annual UPX earnings
- **4 missions completed (2.5x):** 12.25% annual UPX earnings
- **5 missions completed (3x):****14.7% annual UPX earnings**
- **10 missions completed (3.1x):****15.2% annual UPX earnings**, the highest tier

Gamified UPX earning introduces a **forward-looking reward system** where tasks completed in the current season determine the UPX earnings for the following season.

For example,** tasks completed** during **Harvest Season **will set the earning rate for the upcoming **Wonderland Season**. Similarly, activities undertaken in Wonderland Season will influence earnings for the next season, and so on.

Golden leaves. Lantern-lit streets. A bakery on the corner and a new story waiting down the road. **Storybook Harvest** is coming to Upland, bringing four collectible Season Pass designs, weekly cosmetic drops, and a **Harvest Fusion Pass** for collectors ready to bring the whole story together.

**Harvest Season begins Thursday, October 1.** Whether you are putting the finishing touches on a favorite property, growing your collection, or getting ready for your first Trove discoveries, it is time to turn the page.

### Welcome to Storybook Harvest

This season trades summer heat for the charm of an autumn storybook: warm storefronts, colorful trees, cozy neighborhood corners, and a little mystery after sunset. It is a celebration of the places that make a neighborhood feel like home, and the discoveries that make you want to see what is around the next corner.

**What Your Pass Unlocks:**

- One of four unique, collectible Harvest pass designs
- Six weekly cosmetic drops, with one new drop each week
- A **Wildcard Token** for Gamified Earnings Completionists
- A **Harvest season badge** for your profile
- A contribution to your **Seasonal and All-Time Collector Score** through Season Passes and Badges
- The opportunity to complete the **Harvest Fusion Pass** collection **Price:** $6.99

### Troves Are Coming This Harvest

The season’s biggest discovery is still ahead. **Troves are expected to launch during October**, opening a new collecting and progression experience in Upland.

The Genesis Week beta offered a first look at 180 Troves reaching three levels deep. For launch, the team is preparing **over 500 Troves and deeper evolving recipes** alongside a **brand-new progression system**. That means a much larger collection to explore and more discoveries waiting beyond your first find.

Think of Harvest as the start of a new chapter: seasonal collectibles to pursue week by week, and a new Trove journey on the horizon. Give your favorite properties some attention, keep your plants cared for, and get ready to discover what comes next.

# Introducing the Upland Kart Open: A New Weekly Racing Opportunity

August 03, 2026

**Editor's note: For Week 3's competition and beyond, we are adding a new stipulation! You will only have 3 attempts at setting a fastest time, so make sure to hone those skills on the track ahead of qualifying so you know the tracks like the back of your hand!**

A new way to **get started with racing** is coming to Upland!

The **Upland Kart Open** is a **free weekly contest** designed for new and developing racers who want to try competitive racing in a fun, accessible format. Each Kart Open will run alongside the [Pro Racing Championship](https://www.upland.me/events/sizzle-2026-a-new-championship-racing-year-begins), using the same track and the same weekly competition window.

There is **no season-long leaderboard**, championship standing, or long-term commitment. **Every week is a fresh contest** and a new opportunity to race.

**New to racing** or looking for tips? Head to the **Race Chat** channel in the Upland app or on Discord to meet other racers, ask questions, and **learn how to get started**.

The Kart Open will run across** five weekly contests across the following speedways**:

​**Update: ** The track for the first week was found to have an error on it. We have now switched to **Goose Island 1097 N Cherry Ave, Chicago** as the first week’s race track.

**Update:** The track for the third week was found to have an error on it. We have now switched to **1 Crazy Pigeon 915 Pennsylvania Ave, Trenton **as the third week’s race track.

- **August 6–10:** Tyner Zephyr
- **August 13–17:** Road Rager Square
- **August 20–24:** Rancho Oakey
- **August 27–31:** Do Galeao
- **September 3–7:** Country Club Drive Each weekly contest runs from **Thursday at 9:00 AM PT through Monday at 9:00 AM PT**, with the following prize pool awarded every week:

- **1st Place:** 25,000 UPX
- **2nd Place:** 15,000 UPX
- **3rd Place:** 10,000 UPX Here’s **everything you need** to know before you hit the track.

### Free to Enter

The Kart Open has **no registration fee**.

Each weekly contest will run from **Thursday at 9:00 AM PT through Monday at 9:00 AM PT**, matching the Pro Racing Championship qualifying window.

Racers will compete on **the same community-created track featured in that week’s championship event**, bringing the whole racing community together around one schedule and one course.

### How It Works

The weekly Kart Open leaderboard will be ranked by each racer’s **fastest single completed run**.

- **Power-Ups:** Not permitted These requirements may change from race to race to mix things up. Any changes will be announced before that week’s contest begins; otherwise, the standard requirements above will apply.

# Istanbul Gets a 25% Construction Boost This Weekend

November 12, 2026

Istanbul is ready for a building weekend. From **Friday, November 13, 2026 at 9 AM PT** through **Monday, November 16, 2026 at 9 AM PT**, property owners can put **25% more construction power** behind eligible builds and push their structures closer to completion.

Finish the structure that has been waiting, move a block toward your vision, and invite friends to help shape neighborhoods that are ready to welcome new residents.

### Build Istanbul Together

This is the weekend to t**urn plans into progress**. Choose the Istanbul property you want to move forward, rally friends around the build, and watch one project after another **move closer to the finish line**.

Bring back an Upland friend who has been away, invite someone new to discover the city, and help develop neighborhoods with more finished buildings ready to welcome residents. Every project adds another piece to the **Istanbul you want to see**.

- **Boost Starts:** Friday, November 13, 2026 at 9 AM PT
- **Boost Ends:** Monday, November 16, 2026 at 9 AM PT
- **Where:** All Eligible construction in Istanbul
- **Boost:** 25% additional construction power

### How the 25% Boost Works

**The 25% event boost applies to one standalone structure at a time on each property in Istanbul**, prioritizing the structure closest to completion. Once that structure is finished, the boost moves to the next structure closest to completion. All structures continue receiving their staked SPARKLET, but only the selected structure receives the boost on contributions from the owner, other players, and deployed construction vehicles.

**Construction Crews **operate as usual**.** On a property with multiple builds, the Construction Crew supports the structure closest to completion, then moves to the next closest.

Here are a few quick examples of effective construction power during the event:

- **Your own stake:** 100 staked SPARKLET provides 125 construction power during the event.
- **Help from another player or a vehicle:** Your 100 SPARKLET plus 100 from another player or a construction vehicle provides 250 total construction power.
- **Combine all three:** Your 100 SPARKLET, another player’s 100, and a vehicle contributing 100 provides 375 total construction power.
- **With a Construction Crew:** 100 staked SPARKLET plus three different vehicles contributing 100 each provides 507 construction power. The owner and vehicle contributions become 500 after the boost. The crew’s 5% bonus is separately boosted to 6.25% and rounded up to 7%, adding 7% more based on the 100 staked SPARKLET. These figures represent construction power, not extra SPARKLET deposited into your wallet. Vehicles contribute to the boosted build total rather than receiving a separate second 25% multiplier.

# Istanbul Is Coming to Upland

October 26, 2026

The wait is over. **Istanbul, Türkiye** is coming to Upland on **Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 9 AM PT**.

Positioned on the Bosphorus where Europe and Asia meet, Istanbul carries more than **2,000 years of political, religious, and artistic history**. Known across its long history as **Byzantium and Constantinople**, the city served as the capital of the Eastern Roman and Ottoman empires. Now its layered history, waterfront character, and unmistakable energy are ready to open **a new chapter in Upland**.

This will be **Upland’s first city release to open with Troves**, giving players even more to discover as they explore Istanbul. If you know an Uplander who has been waiting for a reason to return, or a friend ready to discover Upland for the first time, **invite them to arrive with you**.

### Hot Air Balloon Celebration

Celebrate Istanbul’s arrival with a **first-of-its-kind Hot Air Balloon Trove celebration**. The celebration takes off one hour after the city opens, on **Thursday, October 29 at 10 AM PT**, when hot air balloons go live in Upland across Istanbul.

The balloons give players a **chance to collect special Troves** that are **normally obtainable only through recipes**. For this celebration, you can **collect those Troves directly**, without fulfilling the recipes normally needed to obtain them. With a chance to even get some troves that haven’t yet been released!

A **25-minute cooldown** applies, and the balloons will **relocate randomly every hour across Istanbul** throughout the celebration. Explore the map and return throughout the weekend for more chances to collect before the celebration ends on **Saturday, October 31st at 9 AM PT**.

We have never done a celebration like this before, and it is just **a small preview of what Troves make possible**. They give us new ways to bring rewards, exploration, and special events together, creating more reasons to jump in and discover what is happening across Upland.

**And for the first time in Upland, we are showing off real-time movement on the map.**

That’s right: the hot air balloons will move around in the air above a property in real time. This is the first time we are bringing real-time animation and movement into the game, and we are excited for you to see it. It is **a preview of what is to come in Upland’s future**.

**Don’t miss this special occasion.** Come to Istanbul, collect special Troves, and see the balloons in motion for yourself!

**Celebration Starts:** Thursday, October 29 at 10 AM PT
**Celebration Ends:** Sat, October 31st at 9 AM PT
**Cooldown:** 25 minutes
**Balloon Movement:** Random relocation every hour across Istanbul

### Build Your Collection

# Karts, Competition, and 500,000 UPX: The Harvest Kart Classic Is Here!

November 13, 2026

*Editors Note: Kart Classic Leaderboard is *[LIVE HERE](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/ebead2e2-5205-4690-a4d3-efc4dfaa019d)​

Harvest season is here, and this weekend **Karts are taking the spotlight**. The **Harvest Kart Classic** brings three days of racing, **500,000 UPX in prizes**, and friendly rivalry to **Sunset Sprintway **in Los Angeles. If you have never raced a Kart, this is **your invitation** to take the starting line and set your first time.

Returning racers, bring your friends, line up together, and compare every run. Put down a time you are proud of, then come back the next day and try to beat it.

### How the Harvest Kart Classic Works

The **Harvest Kart Classic** is a three-day racing challenge where every second counts. Each day, you’ll have **three official attempts** to set your fastest time. Your best valid time from those attempts counts toward your final score.

Each daily scoring window begins at **9 AM PT and runs until 9 AM PT the following day**, giving you a fresh set of three attempts every day.

At the end of the event, your **three daily best times are added together**, and the racer with the lowest combined time wins! To qualify for the leaderboard, you must record a valid time in all three daily scoring windows.

- **Starts**: Friday, November 13, 2026 at 9 AM PT
- **Ends**: Monday, November 16, 2026 at 9 AM PT
- **Venue**: Sunset Sprintway
- **Address**: 4862 Santa Monica BLVD
- **Race Type**: Public races
- **Entry Fee**: 100 UPX
- **Vehicle Class**: Karts only
- **MPS Setting**: Fixed at 80 MPS
- **AI Opponents**: ON

**Rules**

- **Official Attempts**: Your first three eligible race starts in each scoring window are your only official attempts. Attempts are counted when the race starts, not when it finishes.
- **Concurrent and Unfinished Races**: Concurrent starts each count as an attempt. Abandoned or unfinished races also consume an attempt and do not produce a valid time.
- **Daily Best Time**: Your fastest valid finish from your three official attempts becomes your time for that scoring window.
- **Final Score**: Your three daily best times are added together, and the lowest combined time wins.
- **Qualification**: You must record a valid time in all three scoring windows to qualify.
- **Attempt Limits**: Starts after your first three official attempts cannot improve your score, and unused attempts do not carry over. Grab your Kart, invite a friend, and come back for each new scoring window to give it your best shot.

### Prize Pool

A massive 500,000 UPX prize pool is up for grabs, with rewards for the top 25 racers who prove they’ve got what it takes to dominate the track!

# Meet Upland’s Trusted Ambassadors

July 23, 2026

Since Discord became Upland’s default in-game chat, more players than ever are entering the community, asking questions, and discovering Upland together.

That connection **creates an enormous opportunity**, but it also creates a need.

New players need friendly, knowledgeable people who are active in Discord, ready to answer questions, and **willing to help** them find their footing. Fortunately, many of you have already stepped up.

You have welcomed new players, explained complicated systems, shared useful resources, and reached out to people who needed help without being asked.

**We noticed. **Now, we are making that recognition official.

Meet the **Trusted Upland Ambassadors**.

### A Community Role That Matters

The Trusted Upland Ambassador role is a new **prestige role in Discord** created to recognize players who consistently make Upland more welcoming and easier to understand.

Ambassadors are experienced community members who spend significant time in Discord and genuinely enjoy meeting new players, answering their questions, and helping them become part of Upland.

**This is not a moderation role.**

Ambassadors are not responsible for enforcing rules, issuing warnings, or replacing Upland’s moderators. We already have moderators dedicated to keeping the community safe and respectful.

Ambassadors have a different mission: **building connections**.

They are the people who greet someone joining chat for the first time, answer the question everyone else has heard a hundred times, and make sure new players do not feel like they are figuring everything out alone.

They make Upland** easier to enter** and harder to leave.

### Every Contribution Matters

Upland’s community is built by people **contributing in many different ways**.

Some create videos, guides, podcasts, or livestreams. Others organize events, share Upland across social media, create artwork, lead neighborhoods, moderate conversations, or support the community behind the scenes.

**Every one of those contributions matters.**

The Trusted Ambassador role does not replace, outrank, or take away from any of them. It **recognizes one specific type of contribution** that has become increasingly important since Discord became Upland’s default in-game chat.

This role is specifically for **Discord power users**: players who are online frequently, active in conversations, and available to welcome and help new players as they enter chat.

It is not a measure of who contributes the most. It is recognition for people filling a particular need.

### What Trusted Ambassadors Do

Trusted Ambassadors will be active throughout Upland’s Discord community, with a particular focus on supporting new players.

You may see them:

- Welcoming new players and starting conversations
- Reaching out to people who appear lost or unsure
- Answering common gameplay questions
- Helping players understand Upland’s systems and features
- Directing players toward useful guides and resources
- Introducing new players to other members of the community
- Encouraging helpful and respectful conversations This role is for players who are **online regularly**, **actively participate in Discord**, and genuinely enjoy befriending and helping others.

It is not about having every answer. It is about being **approachable, patient, consistent, and willing to help**.

### Recognition Across Upland

Trusted Ambassadors deserve more than a quiet thank-you.

They will receive:

- The exclusive **Trusted Ambassador Discord role**
- A recognizable **in-game badge**
- A direct line to the Upland Team via a private Ambassador Discord channel
- Recognition through recurring **Ambassador Spotlights**

This is not simply another label beside a username. It is a visible mark of **trust, contribution, and community leadership**.

When you see a Trusted Upland Ambassador, you will know you are speaking with someone recognized for their knowledge, consistency, and willingness to help.

### The First Ambassador Class

The first group of Trusted Upland Ambassadors will be **hand-picked** from players who are already doing the work.

These are players who consistently spend time in Discord, welcome new faces, answer questions, and help the community move forward without waiting for recognition.

**The badge does not create an Ambassador.**

It recognizes someone who has already earned that trust through their actions. This first class will establish the standard for what being a Trusted Upland Ambassador means.

Over the **coming days and weeks**, we will **begin approaching players** who we believe embody what this role is meant to represent. No Ambassadors have been selected yet, and the first class will be **formed thoughtfully** over time.

### Could You Become an Ambassador?

This program is only the beginning, and it will grow over time. There is no application to complete and no campaign to run.

Future Ambassadors will be recognized based on how they **consistently show up in Discord**, how active they are, how they treat people, and the difference they make for new players over time.

If you enjoy befriending new players, answering questions, and helping people understand Upland, keep doing it.

**Be active. Be patient. Be welcoming. Help because the community matters.**

**Upland is paying attention.**

### The Players Who Make Upland Feel Alive

Upland is more than properties, collections, businesses, and competition. It is also the people who make someone’s first experience** feel welcoming**.

To everyone creating content, organizing events, sharing Upland, moderating conversations, answering questions, or helping the community in your own way: **thank you**.

You are playing an **important part** in Upland’s future.

The Trusted Ambassador role is our way of recognizing the Discord power users who are there **when new players arrive **and help turn their first question into their first connection.

The first Trusted Ambassadors **are coming. **Watch for the badge. **Remember the names**.

# Put Your Uppies to Work

August 18, 2026

*Editors Note: This feature is now live! *

Uppie automation is almost here!

**Within the next week**, players will be able to assign eligible Uppies to their properties and have them **automatically care for plants on those properties**. **You will still need to feed your plants**, but your assigned Uppies will handle their ongoing care.

This is a** major step forward** for Upland. It gives Uppies **real gameplay utility**, gives properties another meaningful purpose, and connects Life, property ownership, and Uppies in one shared system for the first time.

**With Troves coming soon**, caring for plants will matter even more. **All plants in Upland are planned to produce Troves when the Troves system launches**, making the Life you maintain today part of **Upland’s future** collection and progression gameplay.

### What Uppie Automation Does

Any Uppie that is **Level 3 or higher** can be assigned to one of your properties. Once assigned, that Uppie will automatically care for the plants on that property.

The core loop is simple:

- Assign an eligible Uppie to a property.
- Keep feeding the plants on that property.
- Your Uppie handles their ongoing care, through petting, automatically. This removes a major piece of plant-management busywork while **rewarding players **who have **collected **and l**eveled up** their Uppies.

### How to Assign an Uppie

We have also cleaned up the property card to make its most important actions easier to find. **Sell, Build, Arrange, and Assign Uppie** will now **live together under Manage**, creating a cleaner and more intuitive property experience.

To assign an Uppie:

- Open the property card for the property you want to manage.
- Select Manage.
- Select Assign Uppie.
- Browse or search your eligible **Level 3 or higher** Uppies.
- Select the Uppie you want, choose Assign, and confirm the assignment.

If an Uppie is already assigned, its current property address will appear in the assignment screen. You can also move that Uppie to a different property if you choose.

After an Uppie is assigned, you can check the assignment in two places:

- Open your **Asset Wallet** and select Uppies to see which property each Uppie is assigned to.
- Open the property card and select the Uppie indicator in the upper-right corner to see the assigned Uppie and its details.

There are a few important details to know before assigning an Uppie:

Source: https://www.upland.me/events/put-your-uppies-to-work

After an Uppie is assigned, you can check the assignment in two places:

- Open your **Asset Wallet** and select Uppies to see which property each Uppie is assigned to.
- Open the property card and select the Uppie indicator in the upper-right corner to see the assigned Uppie and its details.

There are a few important details to know before assigning an Uppie:

- Only **Level 3 or higher** Uppies are eligible for property assignment.
- An assigned Uppie becomes **unavailable for merging, sale, or swap** while it remains assigned to a property.
- If a property is **sold or swapped while an Uppie is assigned**, the Uppie will remain with its **original owner**.
- An assigned Uppie becomes **unavailable for merging** while it remains assigned to a property.
- Plants that are already unwell will not become healthy immediately. As they are fed and cared for, their wellness will **recover gradually over time**.
- Plants may still take random damage. As long as an Uppie remains assigned and the plants continue to be fed, the Uppie’s automated care will help them recover.
- **Feeding is not automated.** Players are still responsible for feeding their plants.

### More Uppies Are Coming

Another **Uppie sale** is coming this week to help players prepare for property assignment. Whether you need your first Uppies or want more options to merge toward **Level 3 and above**, this is your chance to get ready.

**Registration Opens:** Thursday, August 20 at 9 AM PT
**Sale Begins:** Friday, August 21 at 9 AM PT

### Launching Within the Next Week

Uppie property assignment and plant care automation will go live in Upland **within the next seven days**. We will announce the **exact launch day** as soon as the feature is ready.

**Uppies are ready to do more. Properties are ready to come alive. Automation is almost here!**

Get your properties ready, level up your Uppies, and stay tuned for the launch and upcoming Uppie sale.

# See Upland Like Never Before: The Next-Gen Visual Upgrade Is Coming

September 22, 2026

**Troves are coming**, and our immediate focus is getting them finished and into your hands. With launch now expected during **October**, we’re taking the additional time to test and polish a much bigger experience: **over 500 Troves and deeper evolving recipes**, compared with the **180 Troves **in the Genesis Week test.

**Upland is evolving, and it’s evolving fast.** There is so much happening in Upland to be excited about. In the last year alone, we’ve delivered **more development updates and improvements than in the previous five years combined**, and we’re **not slowing down anytime soon**.

Today, we want to share more of what we’re working on and testing behind the scenes to bring to you after Troves launches. We’re continuing to execute on **our vision for Upland and improve your everyday gameplay in many ways.**

### A Look at What’s Coming After Troves

After Troves have launched, we’ll introduce a **major visual upgrade for Upland** that is already in development.

The upgrade brings** higher-resolution visuals**, sharper detail, and lighting with shadows that give the world more depth, from neighborhood buildings to the plants and objects on your property.

**Every image in this announcement was captured in our in-game test environment.** These are not AI-generated or enhanced images, concept art, or artistic renderings. This is Upland running in tests today.

We’re not announcing a release date for the visual upgrade yet. For now, we want to give you a **preview **of where Upland is headed after Troves.

### Get Closer. See the Difference.

Look at the individual leaves and flowers. The texture of the garden paths. The rocks around a pond, the details on a building, and the map assets that make a property your own.

These close-ups show what this upgrade is about: **more detail to discover in the places you’ve built.** Sharper plants, clearer surfaces, and more defined objects give each property a richer sense of character. Lighting and static shadows add depth to buildings and their surroundings.

You’ve put time, creativity, and care into your properties. We want that work to shine, whether you’re showing off a garden, decorating a business, or exploring what your neighbors have created.

### Your World, Brought Into Focus

Our team has put **significant engineering work** into making this visual improvement possible across devices. The ambition is bigger than a beautiful screenshot: it’s a **more immersive Upland** that players can experience on the devices they already use.

From a single flower to a whole neighborhood, we want the world to reward a closer look.

### Raising The Bar for Upland

Our vision is to **keep pushing Upland forward** with **greater depth, immersion, and visual quality**, while staying true to the player-built world that makes it unique.

# Sizzle 2026: A New Championship Racing Year Begins

July 30, 2026

A new year of Upland Championship Racing starts now, and every racer is back on the starting line.

The **standings have been reset**. **Every racer begins at zero, every racer begins at zero**, and every point earned from Sizzle 2026 forward will build toward the **Genesis 2027 Grand Final**. Whether you are a returning champion or entering the circuit for the first time, this is your chance to establish your place in the **new Championship year**.

Sizzle 2026 brings five weeks of community-built tracks, a Season Championship Final, and several major racing updates designed to make every race more competitive, strategic, and exciting.

**The following updates for racing will go live on Monday August 3rd.**

### Week 5 Is Bonus Points Week

Week 5 will give racers one final chance to close the gap, climb the standings, or protect their position before the Season Championship Final.

Racing during Week 5 will award **bonus points**. The **exact bonus point boost** will be announced before Week 5 begins, so every racer will know what is at stake before qualifying opens.

A difficult early week no longer has to end your season. Stay in the fight, because Week 5 could change everything.

### More Powerful Power-Up Boosts

Power-up boosts have been overhauled to make them **significantly more powerful**. Racers will need to test them, learn how the updated boosts behave, and rethink how they build around the Max Performance Score limit.

Power-ups will no longer feel like a small advantage. Used correctly, they can be the **difference between winning and losing**.

### Stock Cars Are Ready for Professional Racing

Stock Cars have been adjusted to better represent the vehicles they were intended to be. Their performance has been updated to make them a **more viable option** in professional Championship Racing.

Racers should test their Stock Cars again rather than relying on how they performed in previous seasons.

### Track Structures & Textures

The bug that caused structures around some tracks to appear black **has been resolved**. Racers and viewers should now see the track environment as intended. This update also fixes the** wheel texture** issues affecting some vehicles.

The updated version is not currently available on Android, and the iOS update is still under review. Mobile players may therefore continue to experience this issue. For the best and most up-to-date racing experience, **we recommend racing on the web**.

### Join the Lobby as a Racer or Viewer

Players entering a race lobby can now choose whether they are joining as a **Racer or a Viewer**. This gives streamers, commentators, and other community members the ability to join a race and watch the action without competing.

### Register, Race, and Start Your Championship Run

This is Championship Racing, where skill, speed, and strategy lead to real rewards.

### Join the Lobby as a Racer or Viewer

Players entering a race lobby can now choose whether they are joining as a **Racer or a Viewer**. This gives streamers, commentators, and other community members the ability to join a race and watch the action without competing.

### Register, Race, and Start Your Championship Run

This is Championship Racing, where skill, speed, and strategy lead to real rewards.

To compete in the Sizzle 2026 Championship Racing Season, players must purchase the collectible **Sizzle 2026 Championship Racing Pass** from the Upland Store for **30,000 UPX**. The pass sale opens **Thursday, July 30th at 9 AM PT**, with up to **1,000 passes available**.

Players must continue holding the Racing Pass through the eligibility snapshot on **Wednesday, August 5th at 9 AM PT** to compete. Only players holding the pass at that time will be eligible for the season. Your name will appear on the leaderboard after your first race on the designated track.

**All registration UPX** goes directly into the **seasonal prize pool**, creating a purse that will be distributed among the season’s top-performing racers.

**Sale Start**: Thursday, July 30 9 AM PT
**Sale End**: Wednesday, August 5th 8 AM PT
**Snapshot**: Wednesday, August 5th 9 AM PT

### Sizzle 2026 Racing Schedule

Registered racers will compete each week on a public community-designed track. Qualifying runs from Thursday through Monday, with each week’s finals taking place on Friday.

# ​**Update:  The track for the first week was found to have an error on it. We have now switched to Goose Island 1097 N Cherry Ave, Chicago as the first week’s race track. ​
**

### Sizzle Season Championship Final: Paris Track by Upland Bureau

- **Distance:** 6.63 miles
- **Address:** 28 Rue de Valois, Paris, France
- **Finals:** Friday, September 18th at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET **Alternate tracks:** Goose Island Raceway in New York and 1 Crazy Pigeon 0 may be used if issues arise with the scheduled track.

### Built by the Community, for the Community

Upland provides the tools and platform, but Championship Racing is led by the community. **Community Racing Commissioners****Masschef** and **Antman89** will coordinate championship races, live shows, qualifying results, and leaderboard updates throughout the season.

Each week’s racing finals will be featured during the **Weekly Racing Stream**, bringing the competition front and center with live commentary, results, and updated standings.

To join the racing community, ask questions, or follow race-day updates, head to the Racing Channels in the [official Upland Discord](https://discord.com/invite/upland). Players can opt in to racing notifications through the racing role in the #about-racing channel.

### Prizes and Rewards

Every registered racer contributes to the **seasonal prize pool** through the **30,000 UPX** registration fee. Racers will earn weekly UPX prizes based on placement, with payouts tracked and distributed after the Season Championship Final.

Upland will also add a bonus contribution to the **seasonal prize pool**, increasing the rewards available to the top racers. The **top three racers** this season will earn exclusive racing badges recognizing their place on the podium.

Sizzle 2026 is also the first step toward Genesis 2027. Championship Series points earned throughout the new racing year will accumulate across each season and determine who qualifies for the **Genesis 2027 Grand Final**. Annual Championship prizes will include larger UPX payouts, custom-made prizes, and exclusive rewards for Upland’s elite racers, with full details announced closer to Genesis 2027.

### Community Tracks and Creator Rewards

Community-designed track submissions remain open through the **official Upland Discord**. Selected tracks will be reviewed for fairness, balance, and reliable racing before being featured in official competition.

The creator of each selected track will receive **25,000 UPX** after the track is featured in a live competitive week. Every UPX race completed on a featured track also supports the track owner, so practicing on the official courses helps both racers and the builders behind the raceways.

### Ready to Race?

The road to Genesis 2027 starts with Sizzle 2026.

The standings are clear, the field is wide open, and every racer has the same opportunity to take control of the **new Championship year**. Learn the updated cars. Master the stronger power-ups. Stay within reach of Week 5. Then put everything on the line in Paris.

### Ready to Race?

The road to Genesis 2027 starts with Sizzle 2026.

The standings are clear, the field is wide open, and every racer has the same opportunity to take control of the **new Championship year**. Learn the updated cars. Master the stronger power-ups. Stay within reach of Week 5. Then put everything on the line in Paris.

Who will set the pace for the year ahead? The answer will be decided on the track.

#### Here Are the Complete Racing Rules

*That is everything you need to know about what is new, how to register, where to race, and what is at stake in Sizzle 2026. The remainder of this announcement is the complete rules reference. Returning racers who already know the Championship Racing format can stop reading here.*

***Season Format***

- *The Sizzle 2026 Championship Racing Season includes five weeks of competitive racing followed by the Season Championship Final in Week 6.*
- *Each week features a public community-designed track selected by the Racing Commissioners.*
- *Qualifying runs from Thursday at 9 AM PT through Monday at 9 AM PT.*
- *Racers may run the qualifying track as many times as they want. Only their fastest time counts.*
- *The top 24 fastest drivers qualify for that week’s competition.*
- *Weekly points accumulate across the five-week Sizzle season and determine who advances to the Sizzle Season Championship Final.*
- *The top 12 racers after five weeks advance to the Season Championship Final in Week 6.*
- *Week 5 is Bonus Points Week. The bonus point boost will be announced before Week 5 qualifying begins.*
- *Results from each Season Championship award points on the annual Championship Series Leaderboard. Those points accumulate across the racing year and determine qualification for the ****Genesis 2027 Grand Final****.* ***Race Settings and Advancement***

- ***Max Performance Score Cap:**** All Championship races are limited to MPS 260.*
- ***Public Races:**** All qualifying and competition races must be set to public.*
- ***Qualifying Phase:**** Thursday at 9 AM PT through Monday at 9 AM PT on the designated weekly track.*
- ***Eliminations:**** The six slowest qualifiers are eliminated. The top 18 advance.*
- ***Semi-Finals:**** The 18 advancing racers are split into three balanced heats based on qualifying times:*
- *Heat 1: Positions 1, 6, 7, 12, 13, and 18*
- *Heat 2: Positions 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, and 17*
- *Heat 3: Positions 3, 4, 9, 10, 15, and 16*
- ***Final Heat:**** The top two finishers from each semi-final advance to the Final Heat, for a total of six racers.*
- ***Final Rankings:**** All 24 racers are ranked across the three race phases:*
- *Positions 1 through 6 are based on Final Heat results.*
- *Positions 7 through 18 are based on semi-final race times.*
- *Positions 19 through 24 are based on qualifying times.* ***Weekly Points System***

*Points are awarded by finishing position for all 24 weekly finalists:*

# Sizzle Season 2026 Is Heating Up: Sweat, Build, Earn

July 31, 2026

Sizzle Season missions are live, and the chase for next season’s earnings starts now. The new **Sweat and Build system** follows the ways Uplanders love to play. **Mission costs are down from last season** because we heard the feedback.

### Sweat or Build. Pick Your Path.

Every mission this season is labeled Sweat or Build. Sweat missions are experiences, racing, treasure hunting, exploring the map. Build missions are about building in Upland, construction, minting, decorating. Two ways to play Sizzle Season.

### A Fresh Drop Every Tuesday

There are **10 missions total**: two season-long missions live now and eight weekly missions revealed throughout the season.

One or two new missions drop **every Tuesday at 9 AM PT**. The deadline is the following **Tuesday at 7 AM PT**. Only the current week’s missions can be completed, and missed missions cannot be recovered. Every Tuesday is a fresh chance to jump back in.

### Show Up or Go for the Sweep

- Complete **any 5 of the 10 missions** for a **14.7% earnings**, the reward for showing up regularly.
- Complete **all 10 missions** for the maximum **15.2% earnings** and finish the full Sizzle run. With an activated Sizzle Season Pass, completionists can also bring home **Wave Rider 26**, an exclusive surfboard trophy Block Explorer. The Season Pass Wildcard can cover one missed weekly mission for Block Explorer eligibility.

### The Season-Long Chase Is Live

- Net increase in Influence Score
- Net increase in Residents Both are measured from **Wednesday, July 15 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, September 15 at 9 AM PT**.

The baseline is the end of last season, so growth between seasons already counts for you, and there is no benefit to shrinking builds before a season starts.

### Week 1: Send and Sizzle (Aug 4–11)

The opening drop runs from **Tuesday, August 4 at 9 AM PT** to **Tuesday, August 11 at 7 AM PT**.

- **Sweat:** Do 10 paid sends to 10 unique properties in Upland
- **Build:** Decorate 5 structures with Sizzle Season Ornaments. Must be one ornament per property to count. Get moving, fire up the decorations, and put your first two missions on the board.

# Sizzle Season 2026: Turn Up the Heat

July 30, 2026

Sizzle Season is here, bringing six weeks of collectibles, challenges, and rewards to Upland. From developing properties and building across your neighborhoods to trading, collecting, and taking on season activities, every part of Upland gives you another way to make this season count.

**Sizzle Season 2026** runs from **Saturday, August 1 through Tuesday, September 15**. At the center of it all is the **Sizzle Season Pass**, your entry point to weekly cosmetic drops, a season badge, a Gamified Earnings safety net, and the chance to complete the ultimate Sizzle collection.

As always, **Season Passes and Badges** contribute to both your **Seasonal** and **All-Time **[Collector Score](https://www.upland.me/events/introducing-the-collector-score-a-new-way-to-showcase-your-upland-prestige), giving every unlock lasting value beyond the season itself.

### Sizzle Season Pass: One Burn Unlocks the Season

The **Sizzle Season Pass** is built to be simple. Buy the pass, **burn it to activate**, and you are set for the season. One burn makes your account eligible for all future weekly Sizzle drops, adds a season-specific badge to your profile, and starts your Sizzle collecting journey.

There is no separate level track to grind through inside the pass. Your progression comes from staying active, collecting the weekly rewards, completing Sizzle activities, and assembling the four character collectibles needed for the **Sizzle Fusion Pass**.

**What Your Pass Unlocks:**

- One of Four unique, collectible Sizzle passes
- Six weekly cosmetic drops, with one new drop each week
- A **Wildcard Token** for Gamified Earnings Completionists
- A Sizzle season badge for your profile
- A boost to your **Sizzle Season Collector Score**
- Eligibility to complete the **Sizzle Fusion Pass** collection

**Starts:** Saturday, August 1 at 9:00 AM PT
**Ends:** Available throughout Sizzle Season, through Tuesday, September 15
**Price:** $6.99

### Activate Once, Collect All Season

Each week, Upland takes a snapshot of eligible players at **7:00 AM PT on Tuesday**. To receive that week’s cosmetic drop, your **Sizzle Season Pass** must be activated by burning it before the snapshot.

You only need to **burn one pass for the entire season**. Once activated, your account remains eligible for all subsequent weekly cosmetic drops. The earlier you activate, the more of the complete Sizzle collection you can secure.

Weekly rewards are tied to your account after they are delivered. Missing a weekly snapshot means missing that week’s drop, so activate before the first snapshot you want to qualify for.

### Mission Wildcard Token: Protection for Completionists

Every burned **Sizzle Season Pass** includes a **Wildcard Token** for Gamified Earnings Completionists. If you stay active throughout the season but miss exactly one weekly Gamified Earnings mission, the Wildcard automatically fills that single gap at the end of the season and keeps you eligible for the **Completionist Block Explorer reward**.

The Wildcard protects a Completionist run. It does not replace the work required to earn general Gamified Earnings rewards.

**How It Works:**

Every burned **Sizzle Season Pass** includes a **Wildcard Token** for Gamified Earnings Completionists. If you stay active throughout the season but miss exactly one weekly Gamified Earnings mission, the Wildcard automatically fills that single gap at the end of the season and keeps you eligible for the **Completionist Block Explorer reward**.

**How It Works:**

- Included with every burned **Sizzle Season Pass**
- Applies only to weekly Gamified Earnings missions
- Automatically activates if you miss exactly one weekly mission
- Does not apply to season-long Residents or Influence missions
- Does not count toward the five-mission minimum for general Gamified Earnings rewards
- Can be used only once Think of it as a safety net for players who show up all season but need a little protection when one week gets away from them. Full Sizzle Gamified Earnings requirements and rewards will be covered in the separate Gamified Earnings announcement.

### Complete the Collection and Earn the Sizzle Fusion Pass

The **Sizzle Fusion Pass** is the season’s ultimate collector reward. To qualify, assemble** all four **unique Sizzle character collectibles and make sure they are recorded in your account when the Fusion snapshot is taken.

Whether you **keep the characters in your wallet or burn them**, all four must be associated with your account **at snapshot time**. You must then maintain the qualifying collection for at least 24 hours after the snapshot so eligibility can be verified.

**Fusion Pass Snapshot:** Tuesday, September 8, 2026 at 9:00 AM PT
**Requirement:** All four unique Sizzle characters must be in your account at snapshot time
**Hold Time:** Keep the complete qualifying collection in your account for at least 24 hours after the snapshot

The snapshot is final for **Sizzle Fusion Pass** qualification. Any character added to your account after **9:00 AM PT on September 8** will not count toward the Sizzle Fusion Pass for this season.

Once eligibility has been verified, qualifying players will receive the **Sizzle Fusion Pass**, adding another collectible to their account and another boost to their **Season Collector Score**.

### Make Sizzle Season Count

The **Sizzle Season Pass** turns one simple activation into a season-long collecting experience. Burn your pass, stay eligible for the weekly drops, use the Wildcard as protection for your Completionist run, and bring all four characters together before the Fusion snapshot.

Your properties, collections, builds, trades, and participation already shape your place in Upland. Sizzle Season gives you another way to turn that activity into rewards that remain part of your collection after the season ends.

**Get the Sizzle Season Pass, turn up the heat, and make every week count.**

# Sizzle Summer Starts Early in Upland

# Store More. Decorate Freely. Meet Upland Storage Facilities.

November 17, 2026

*Editor’s Note (November 17): Storage Clarification*

*We’ve seen some questions about how Storage works, so let’s clear a few things up!*

- ***Storage is OPTIONAL****. It’s a convenience feature, not a requirement to own or decorate with map assets.*
- ***Your wallet remains unlimited****. You can continue owning as many map assets as you want. Nothing changes there.*

- ***Your properties aren’t limited by Storage****. Storage does not introduce new restrictions on how many map assets you can place.*

- ***Storage makes decorating easier****. Keep assets you want quick access to and move them between Storage and your properties directly from the new decorating interface, without leaving the property you’re decorating.*

- ***Everyone gets 25 FREE slots****. Every player receives these when Storage launches, with no purchase required.*

- ***Want more convenience?**** Build optional Storage Facilities to expand your capacity when the system launches.* *Here’s the simplest way to think about it:*

- ***Wallet****: Where you own unlimited map assets.*
****
- ***Properties****: Where you place and display your assets.*
****
- ***Storage****: An optional convenience for quickly accessing and moving assets between properties.*
- ***The bottom line****: Storage doesn’t limit what you own or require you to purchase anything. It simply makes decorating with your existing assets easier!*
*---* Decorating your properties in Upland is about to get a whole** lot more flexible**. Today, we’re introducing **Storage Facilities**, a new way to expand your storage capacity and prepare for the future of property decorating in Upland.

With **four new buildable Storage Facilities**, players will be able to expand their storage capacity, giving them more room to move map assets between storage and their properties when the redesigned decorating experience launches. And for the first 24 hours, **all four blueprints will be available together in a discounted bundle.**

As with previous early adopter opportunities in Upland, **there’s no need to purchase now to enjoy Storage when it launches.** These blueprints will remain available, but players who want to get a head start can take advantage of **special early adopter pricing** for a limited time.

Let’s take a look at how Storage will work, what’s coming to decorating, and how you can start building your storage capacity today.

### A New Way to Decorate Is Coming

We recently gave players a[first look at the future of decorating in Upland](https://www.upland.me/events/your-property-your-vision-a-whole-new-way-to-build), featuring a redesigned interface that will make customizing your properties easier than ever. Players will be able to browse their map assets, drag and drop them directly onto properties, and bring their creative visions to life with greater freedom and flexibility.

**Planting is getting easier, too!** The new editor will let players access their seeds directly from the decorating interface and **plant in batches**, making it faster and more convenient to bring gardens and green spaces to life across their properties.

Source: https://www.upland.me/events/store-more-decorate-freely-meet-upland-storage-facilities

**Planting is getting easier, too!** The new editor will let players access their seeds directly from the decorating interface and **plant in batches**, making it faster and more convenient to bring gardens and green spaces to life across their properties.

But what happens when you’re ready to change things up? That’s where **Storage** comes in.

The redesigned decorating experience is still in development, with a release date to be announced.

[Watch the Decorating Preview](https://youtu.be/2gce7SFLzjE)

### Introducing Storage

To make decorating easier than ever, we’re introducing **Storage**, a dedicated area within your wallet that will make managing and placing map assets on your properties** more convenient **than ever.

When the new decorating experience launches, **you’ll be able to access Storage directly from the property you’re decorating, without ever leaving the decorating screen.** Simply browse your stored map assets, place them on your property, and return them to Storage whenever you’re ready for a new look. No jumping between properties or navigating back and forth through menus. Everything you need will be right there as you decorate!

**One important distinction: Vehicles are not supported by Storage.** Vehicles cannot be placed in Storage or moved between properties through the Storage interface. Once a vehicle is placed on a property, it must be driven to its next destination.

Every player will receive **25 free storage slots** when the system activates. And don’t worry, **there’s no limit to how many map assets you can own in your wallet.** Storage slots simply determine **how many items you can keep in Storage** as part of the new decorating experience.

### Build More Storage, Unlock More Space

Want more than the default 25 slots? That’s where **Storage Facilities** come in.

Starting with this sale, players can purchase blueprints for four different Storage Facilities and begin constructing them on their properties. Each completed facility will provide additional storage capacity once the Storage system activates.

**Every blueprint is reusable**, meaning you can construct the same Storage Facility as many times as you want, on properties throughout Upland. The more facilities you build, the more storage capacity you’ll have.

**Important:** Purchasing a blueprint or completing a facility won’t immediately unlock storage slots. Additional capacity becomes available when the future Storage system launches, and only for **completed facilities**. Individual blueprints will remain available in the store after the limited-time bundle ends.

### Get Your Storage On

Ready to start building your storage capacity? **Four new Storage Facility blueprints are now available**, giving players the opportunity to prepare for the future of decorating in Upland.

To celebrate their arrival, we’re offering a **special 24-hour bundle that includes all four blueprints at 25% off!** Each blueprint is also available individually at its regular price and will remain in the store after the bundle offer ends.

Here’s a look at what’s available.

### Complete Storage Blueprint Bundle

# Troves 1.0 Is Fully Launched: Level 100, Rare Genomes, and More to Discover

November 03, 2026

The initial full launch of **Troves** is here. With **over 500 Troves**, **over 700 recipes**, new **Platinum and Diamond banking tiers**, and **Upland progression now open to Level 100**, the complete first chapter of Troves has arrived. Explore new finds across the map, turn them into ingredients, craft higher-level Troves, and** build toward the biggest progression goals** yet.

This is the **final phase of the initial Troves launch**, but it is only the beginning of what comes next. **Uppie Quests** are up next, and rare **Genome rewards** will begin dropping from certain crafting recipes in the **coming days**. Beyond that, **automation, farms, trade routes, fishing, and more** are on the horizon, bringing new ways to collect, craft, and explore Upland.

### More Room to Progress, with Automation Ahead

**All remaining Troves and recipes** in the launch are **now live**, along with **Platinum and Diamond banking tiers** and a progression cap of** Level 100**. There is plenty to explore, craft, and work toward, with progression through **Level 75** achievable through manual collecting and crafting.

**Progression beyond Level 75**, along with Platinum and Diamond banking, is **designed specifically for automation**. These goals require resource quantities that will be extremely difficult to gather and craft by hand. Although they are unlocked now, they are not intended to be practical targets through manual play alone. **Upcoming automation** will provide the** large-scale collection and crafting** needed to pursue them.

For now, keep **discovering Troves**, **fulfilling recipes**, and** banking **toward your next milestone. Banking remains the primary way to increase your Upland progression level, and deposits into the Trove Vault are permanent, so keep the ingredients you want to use in recipes before banking them.

**Automation is coming soon**, and we’ll share more about how it will support these higher-tier goals. Level 100 is the current progression cap, with **further increases **planned for the future.

### Rare Genomes

In the coming days, certain crafting recipes will offer **a rare chance to receive a Genome Trove** as an additional reward. Genomes represent animal life, including chickens and cows, giving players something new to discover as they craft.

These Genomes will be **the foundation for living animals** on Upland’s map. In a future update, players will be able to use them as recipe ingredients to bring those animals to life. **Genome rewards will arrive first**, with animal creation coming later. We will announce when these go live.

### Automation Will Power the Next Era of Troves

**Automation** will be a major part of progressing through **Platinum and Diamond**. These banking tiers are available now, but their large requirements are **designed with future automated collection and crafting in mind**.

# Troves Expands Today: Recipes, Gold Banking, and the Road to Level 40

October 27, 2026

Your Trove collection is about to take you further**, **with **new recipes to craf**t, **more Troves to discover**, and **new milestones****to reach.**

Today, **284 crafting recipes** go live at Service Structures, **Gold banking** opens, and **20 additional progression levels** unlock, giving you new goals to pursue all the way to **Level 40**. With this release, there are now **372 total Troves available to collect**. Put your finds to work, craft higher-level Troves, and see how far your collection can take you!

This** first batch of recipes** is just the beginning, with** more arriving** as the **phased Troves launch continues**.

### Turn Your Finds into Higher-Level Troves

Recipes let you use collected Troves as** ingredients to craft higher-level Troves**. Some of those crafted Troves can then become ingredients in other recipes, opening up **even more to discover** as you explore and collect.

Finding a Trove for the first time **reveals the recipes that use it**. Each discovered recipe shows the ingredients you need, so you can see what you already have and what you still need to find.

### How to Craft

- **Discover a recipe.** Find a Trove for the first time to reveal recipes that use it.
- **Gather the ingredients.** Check the recipe’s requirements and keep collecting to fill the gaps.
- **Visit the Service Structure.** Move your Block Explorer to the structure where the recipe is available, open its full-screen view, and select **Craft**.
- **Fulfill the recipe.** Choose an available recipe and use the required ingredients to craft. **Those ingredients are consumed.** *Recipe interface example. Requirements and rewards vary by recipe.*

Each recipe has a main result, and some recipes may also give **additional or rarer Troves**. Keep discovering, crafting, and exploring what your new Troves can become.

*Recipe discovery example. Requirements and rewards vary by recipe.*

### Bank to Gold. Progress to Level 40.

**Gold** joins Bronze and Silver as the **newest banking tier**, while** 20 additional Upland progression levels** raise the current limit to **Level 40**.

Banking is the **primary way** to increase your **Upland progression level**. Permanently deposit Troves into your Trove Vault to meet progression requirements and work toward rewards. Check your profile to see your next milestone, its requirements, and the reward you can earn.

Remember: **banked Troves cannot be withdrawn or used in recipes**, so keep the ingredients you want to craft with before making a deposit.

**Gold is the newest banking tier **to unlock, with **higher tiers coming** as the phased Troves launch continues.

**Your next discovery could become your next ingredient, or help you reach your next milestone.** Head into Upland, try your first recipes, and start working toward Gold. Bring back a friend or introduce someone new: there is more to collect, craft, and explore together.

The wait is almost over: Troves go live in Upland **this Thursday, October 22!** Get ready to **explore**, **start your collection**, and turn your discoveries into** lasting achievements** with **Trove Banking** and the new **Progression System**.

There will be new finds to compare, collections to build, and goals to chase together. If a friend has been looking for a reason to return, or you know someone ready for their first Upland adventure, **bring them along**. This is a launch you can **discover together**.

### Phase One

Your first challenge? See what you can find among **189 unique Troves** available to collect in **phase one**. Explore Upland, compare notes with your neighbors, and start filling your inventory. This first batch is just part of the full collection waiting to unfold.

New Troves, crafting recipes, and more banking tiers will arrive at **regular intervals over the coming weeks**, bringing fresh discoveries and new uses for what you collect. There are **no crafting recipes at launch**, so Thursday is your chance to get out, explore, and get to know your first Troves.

**Each phase gives you time** to build your collection and **learn the mechanics** before the next batch arrives. You can get familiar with what you have found, choose your next goal, and** be ready **when new recipes open up more possibilities.

Troves will **launch in beta **and remain there through the rollout, giving us room to make balancing adjustments as you play. **Beta progression rewards are subject to change** and differ from those planned for the full new-player onboarding experience coming later this year.

All Troves from **Genesis Week** will be removed, except **Genome Troves**, which will **remain **in your inventory.

### Bank Your Collection and Build Your Progress

**Some finds are worth keeping forever**. Trove Banking lets you permanently add Troves to your collection and show off your achievements in the Trove Vault. **Bronze and Silver** banking tiers will be available at launch, with **higher tiers** opening in the** coming phases**.

The choice is yours: bank Troves toward a collection goal, or hold onto them for recipes and other uses as those arrive. Choose carefully, because **banked Troves cannot be withdrawn or used elsewhere**.

**Your Vault **shows how far you have taken each banked Trove, while your Progression level tracks your broader journey through Upland. Together, they give you something to work toward beyond your next discovery: a collection you are proud of and milestones that show how far you have come.

Ready for a little friendly competition? **Troves competitions** are coming during the rollout, too. **Stay tuned **for the challenges and rewards!

### The Bigger Troves Economy Ahead

Collecting manually is where this adventure starts. Further ahead, the challenge grows: how will you gather the quantities needed for **bigger banking goals** and **more ambitious recipes**? That is where **automation** comes in.

# Troves Go Live Today: How to Collect, Bank, and Progress

October 22, 2026

​***Editor’s Note****: We’ve clarified the Block Explorer stamina section to explain that certain event-reward explorers use the same 125-stamina classification as Director Explorers, including some with a 1-of-1 mint count. This clarifies their existing classification; it does not change their stamina or mint count.*​

Troves are going live today, opening a **new way to explore Upland**, discover what different structures and plants hold, build a collection, and turn those discoveries into lasting progress.

This is the beginning of the **Troves beta** and a **phased rollout**, not the finished version of the entire system. The team will be measuring real player activity, reward pacing, progression, and balance as everyone plays. Mechanics and rewards may change during beta, and the full new-player onboarding experience planned for later this year will use different rewards.

Starting in phases gives** everyone time to learn **the loop, build an inventory, and **understand each new batch** as it arrives.

**If a friend** has been waiting for a reason to return, or you know someone who would enjoy discovering Upland for the first time,** invite them to explore with you**. Troves are built for comparing finds, sharing discoveries, and learning **together**.

### What Goes Live Today

Today’s first beta release includes:

- **189 unique Troves** available to discover and collect.
- **Trove Banking** with Bronze and Silver banking tiers.
- **Upland Progression**, with banking as the primary way to advance at launch.
- **Block Explorer stamina**, which powers Trove collection through one shared global pool.
- **No crafting recipes at launch.** Recipes begin rolling out in later batches, so today is about exploring, collecting, learning what different places can hold, and deciding what you may want to bank. New Troves, crafting recipes, and higher banking tiers will **arrive at regular intervals over the coming weeks**. This staged release is** intentional**: it gives you time to collect and understand the system before the next layer opens.

### What Troves Are

Troves are collectible items found throughout Upland. In this first release, you can discover them by visiting **Service Structures** and **plant life **on properties with your Block Explorer. Different structures and plants can hold different possibilities, which makes moving through neighborhoods and trying new locations part of the experience.

Some Troves can be **found directly**. As recipes roll out, collected Troves will also become ingredients that can be used at Service Structures to **craft higher-level Troves**. Some crafted results can then feed into deeper recipes. That creates a path from an everyday discovery to a much larger collection goal.

title: Troves Go Live Today: How to Collect, Bank, and Progress | Upland
text:
Document: Troves Go Live Today: How to Collect, Bank, and Progress | Upland
Source: https://www.upland.me/events/troves-go-live-today-how-to-collect-bank-and-progress

Some Troves can be **found directly**. As recipes roll out, collected Troves will also become ingredients that can be used at Service Structures to **craft higher-level Troves**. Some crafted results can then feed into deeper recipes. That creates a path from an everyday discovery to a much larger collection goal.

**Collecting from structures or plants you own** can already** improve your chances** of finding rarer Troves. A **future update** will add another layer to collecting:** plant maturity** will influence Trove drops. During this beta phase, young plants offer the same Trove drop chances as mature plants, so you can **start collecting right away** without waiting for them to grow.

### How to Collect Your First Trove

- **Move your Block Explorer close to a Service Structure or plant.** Collection is location-based, so your Block Explorer needs to be near the object on the map.
- **Press and hold the structure or plant to collect.** A normal tap opens its details. The press-and-hold interaction is what starts a Trove collection attempt.
- **See what you found.** Your result is added to your Trove inventory, and a first-time discovery begins filling out your collection.
- **Keep moving and exploring.** Each object has its own cooldown for you. Once you have collected from that specific object, visit another structure or plant instead of repeatedly using the same one.

*The Trove collection interaction shown in an earlier Troves preview.*

Cooldowns are tracked **per player and per object**. Your cooldown does not prevent another player from collecting there, and a cooldown on one object does not put every object of that type on cooldown. If you press and hold an object that is still on cooldown for you, the result can be **Trove Dust** instead of another regular find. Dust collection still uses stamina, so exploring fresh locations is the better way to use your available pool.

### Find Everything in Your Trove Wallet

**Tap the Troves icon on the map** to open your Trove Wallet. Here you can see the Troves you hold, your balances, and the categories you have begun to discover. Use it to compare what you have found and decide **what to preserve for progression**.

*Wallet interface preview; example counts may differ at launch*

Once recipes begin rolling out, **discovering a Trove** for the first time will also **reveal available recipes **that consume it. You will be able to see which ingredients a discovered recipe needs, collect the missing pieces, and visit the Service Structure where that recipe is available. On launch day, however, there are **no active crafting recipes**, so collecting and banking are the first playable layers.

### How Block Explorer Stamina Works

Every player receives a **free baseline of 100 stamina**, and the Block Explorers held in your wallet **add more stamina to the same pool**. The entire global pool, including the free baseline, **refills every six hours**. The in-app countdown shows when the next refill is coming.

Document: Troves Go Live Today: How to Collect, Bank, and Progress | Upland
Source: https://www.upland.me/events/troves-go-live-today-how-to-collect-bank-and-progress

### How Block Explorer Stamina Works

Every player receives a **free baseline of 100 stamina**, and the Block Explorers held in your wallet **add more stamina to the same pool**. The entire global pool, including the free baseline, **refills every six hours**. The in-app countdown shows when the next refill is coming.

You do not need to equip an explorer, choose an active explorer, or switch between them. Wallet-held Block Explorers **contribute together** to one shared total. **Every collection attempt **uses that pool, including an attempt that produces Trove Dust.

You can** view stamina from your profile**, the top-left display, the Block Explorers section of your Asset Wallet, and an individual explorer’s full-screen view. When viewing another player’s Block Explorer, the number shown is its **maximum contribution**, not that player’s remaining usable stamina. A transfer **does not reset stamina** that has already been spent; the explorer must wait for the next shared refill with its new owner.

*Stamina interface preview. Example values and timers are illustrative; the launch values and six-hour refill schedule in this guide apply.*

**Launch stamina values by edition size:**

- **1-of-1 explorers:** 1,000 stamina *(Excluding Director Explorers)*
- **2–5 mints:** 750 stamina
- **6–10 mints:** 350 stamina
- **11–24 mints:** 200 stamina
- **25–50 mints:** 125 stamina
- **Director Explorers:** 125 stamina
- **51–100 mints:** 75 stamina
- **101–250 mints:** 40 stamina
- **251–499 mints:** 25 stamina
- **500+ mints:** 10 stamina The initial launch values are beta settings and **may be adjusted** as the team studies real collection activity and balance.

**Mint count and stamina classification**: Certain Block Explorers awarded through events are grouped with Director Explorers for stamina purposes and **contribute 125 stamina each**. This preserves the **highest stamina tier for Terraformers and Genesis Rings** while still giving these event prizes stamina benefits. An explorer’s “1 of 1” label remains accurate, it describes how many of that specific explorer were minted, but does not automatically place it in the 1,000-stamina tier. **Its unique identity** as an earned event reward **remains unchanged**.

Two commemorative collections have approved exceptions: **Little Frights** and **Troves After Dark** explorers each contribute **150 stamina**, even though their edition size would normally fall in the 75-stamina band.

### How to Bank Troves and Build Progress

**Banking is the primary way to increase your Upland Progression level at launch.** Banking means permanently depositing Troves into the **Trove Vault** to meet progression requirements and work toward rewards.
